sentences.en: I *almost* had him at the north stairwell — my hand caught his sleeve — but he dropped a smoke capsule and the neon world went grey and I was left holding nothing but cold air.

especially:1.en: Every block in the Old Quarter had its own coded graffiti, but these markings were different. The symbols near the east gate disturbed me, *especially* the one above the water pipe — a spiral inside a broken circle. Ali said it was a broadcast tag. A live one. Someone was still transmitting from here.
especially:1.cnHint: 叙述者注意到旧城涂鸦，____是东门附近的一个符号。
especially:1.hook: Ali pressed her ear to the pipe and went pale.
especially:1.line: 'Study them all — *especially* the one above the pipe.'

sentences.en: Every block in the Old Quarter had its own coded graffiti, but these markings were different.
sentences.cn: 旧区的每个街区都有自己的编码涂鸦，但这些标记不一样。

sentences.en: The symbols near the east gate disturbed me, *especially* the one above the water pipe — a spiral inside a broken circle.

publish:1.en: The underground printer was small and fast. Grey Crow said someone used it each night to *publish* a one-page bulletin — raw data, city secrets, names of officials who cut the power. Ali gathered the latest sheet off the wet ground. The ink was still warm. Whoever printed it had left thirty seconds ago.
publish:1.cnHint: 地下印刷机每夜____传单，阿栗捡到了最新一份。
publish:1.hook: The final line of the bulletin read: 'They know about you.'
publish:1.line: 'They *publish* the truth here — because nowhere else will.'

sentences.en: The underground printer was small and fast.
sentences.cn: 地下打印机小而快速。

Ali gathered the latest sheet off the wet ground.
sentences.cn: 阿栗从湿漉漉的地面上捡起最新的一张纸。

sentences.en: The ink was still warm.
sentences.cn: 墨迹还是温热的。

sentences.en: Whoever printed it had left thirty seconds ago.
sentences.cn: 印刷这张纸的人三十秒前才离开。

activity:1.en: The plaza looked empty, but Grey Crow was not fooled. 'Watch the shadows,' he said. I scanned the perimeter — a flicker near the fountain, a shape behind the signal post. There was *activity* everywhere once you learned to look. Hidden, quiet, coordinated. The Old Quarter was not sleeping. It was waiting.
activity:1.cnHint: 广场表面平静，实则暗中____不断，旧城正在等待时机。
activity:1.hook: Grey Crow gripped my arm: 'It starts in three minutes.'
activity:1.line: 'There is *activity* in every shadow — stay sharp.'

sentences.en: The plaza looked empty, but Grey Crow was not fooled.
sentences.cn: 广场看起来是空的，但灰鸦没有被迷惑。

sentences.en: 'Watch the shadows,' he said.
sentences.cn: "注意看影子，"他说。

sentences.en: I scanned the perimeter — a flicker near the fountain, a shape behind the signal post.
sentences.cn: 我扫过周边——喷泉附近有一闪，信号塔后面有一个身影。

sentences.en: There was *activity* everywhere once you learned to look.

sentences.en: The Old Quarter was not sleeping.

sentences.en: It was waiting.

science:1.en: The old university building still stood at the edge of Old Quarter, black and silent. Zero had been a student there once, Ali told me — top of his year in signal *science*, the study of how data moves and hides. That made him dangerous. He did not guess where the signal was. He knew.
science:1.cnHint: 阿栗透露零点曾精通信号____，这让他成为最危险的对手。
science:1.hook: A light blinked on in the building's top floor.
science:1.line: 'Signal *science* is his weapon — do not underestimate it.'

sentences.en: The old university building still stood at the edge of Old Quarter, black and silent.
sentences.cn: 旧大学的建筑还屹立在旧区边缘，黑暗而沉寂。

sentences.en: Zero had been a student there once, Ali told me — top of his year in signal *science*, the study of how data moves and hides.
That made him dangerous.
sentences.cn: 那让他很危险。

sentences.en: He did not guess where the signal was.
sentences.cn: 他不是猜测信号在哪里。

sentences.en: He knew.
sentences.cn: 他是知道。

contribute:1.en: The old district's walls were covered in coded graffiti. Grey Crow stopped beside a rusted gate. 'Every mark here *contributes* to a map,' he said quietly. I studied the patterns — they formed something. A route. Underground. Someone had been building this guide for years, piece by piece, in plain sight.
contribute:1.cnHint: 灰鸦指着墙上的涂鸦，说每一个符号都在____着一张秘密地图。
contribute:1.hook: The last symbol pointed directly at my front door.
contribute:1.line: 'Every mark *contributes* to the path — ignore none of them.'

sentences.en: The old district's walls were covered in coded graffiti.
sentences.cn: 老城区的墙上到处都是密码涂鸦。

sentences.en: Grey Crow stopped beside a rusted gate.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦在一扇生锈的铁门旁停了下来。

sentences.en: 'Every mark here *contributes* to a map,' he said quietly.
I studied the patterns — they formed something.
sentences.cn: 我研究着这些图案——它们组成了什么东西。

sentences.en: A route.
sentences.cn: 一条路线。

sentences.en: Underground.
sentences.cn: 地下。

sentences.en: Someone had been building this guide for years, piece by piece, in plain sight.
sentences.cn: 有人多年来一直在建造这份指南，一点点地，就在众目睽睽之下。

share:1.en: Ali crouched beside a broken street lamp and handed me a folded paper. 'My *share* of the map,' she said. 'You carry yours.' The rain hit hard. We each held half of something dangerous. Together the two halves named a place the city had tried to forget for thirty years.
share:1.cnHint: 阿栗把地图撕成两半，把属于自己的那____交给了我。
share:1.hook: Someone across the street had been watching us the whole time.
share:1.line: 'This is my *share* — guard it or we both fall.'

sentences.en: Ali crouched beside a broken street lamp and handed me a folded paper.
sentences.cn: 阿栗蹲在一盏破损的路灯旁，递给我一张折起来的纸。

sentences.en: 'My *share* of the map,' she said.
'You carry yours.'
sentences.cn: 你拿着你的那份。

sentences.en: The rain hit hard.
sentences.cn: 雨下得很急。

sentences.en: We each held half of something dangerous.
sentences.cn: 我们各自拿着某个危险东西的一半。

sentences.en: Together the two halves named a place the city had tried to forget for thirty years.
sentences.cn: 两半合起来标出了这座城市三十年来想要遗忘的地方。

decade:1.en: The signal tower had been dark for a *decade*. Locals crossed the street to avoid it. I did not. Grey Crow had told me that old towers remember old codes, locked inside their dead circuits. I pressed my ear to the cold metal and heard, faint as a breath, a repeating pulse.
decade:1.cnHint: 那座信号塔已经沉默了整整一个____，但我听见了它心跳般的脉冲。
decade:1.hook: The pulse was spelling out a name — mine.
decade:1.line: 'A *decade* of silence means someone worked very hard to keep it quiet.'

sentences.en: The signal tower had been dark for a *decade*.
Locals crossed the street to avoid it.
sentences.cn: 本地人都绕过它走。

sentences.en: I did not.
sentences.cn: 我没有。

sentences.en: Grey Crow had told me that old towers remember old codes, locked inside their dead circuits.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦告诉我，那些废弃的塔楼会记住旧密码，锁在死去的电路里面。

sentences.en: I pressed my ear to the cold metal and heard, faint as a breath, a repeating pulse.
sentences.cn: 我把耳朵贴在冷冰冰的金属上，听到了一个微弱的、像呼吸一样的重复脉冲。

kind:1.en: Zero stepped out of the fog at the corner of Ash Lane. I had expected anger. Instead his voice was almost gentle. 'I know your *kind*,' he said, meaning investigators, meaning people who pull on threads. 'You always find the knot. You never like what is tied inside.' He walked away slowly.
kind:1.cnHint: 零点拦住了我，冷冷地说他见过我这____人，知道我会怎么做。
kind:1.hook: He left a small folded card on the wet ground behind him.
kind:1.line: 'I know your *kind* — curious, careful, and always too late.'

sentences.en: Zero stepped out of the fog at the corner of Ash Lane.
sentences.cn: 零点从灰烬街转角的雾气里走了出来。

sentences.en: I had expected anger.
sentences.cn: 我预计他会很愤怒。

sentences.en: Instead his voice was almost gentle.
sentences.cn: 结果他的声音几乎温柔。

sentences.en: 'I know your *kind*,' he said, meaning investigators, meaning people who pull on threads.
'You always find the knot.
sentences.cn: 你们总能找到那个结。

sentences.en: You never like what is tied inside.'
sentences.cn: 你们从来不喜欢里面绑着的东西。

sentences.en: He walked away slowly.
sentences.cn: 他慢慢走开了。

across:1.en: The bridge was narrow and slick with rain. I ran *across* it without stopping, the encoded broadcast looping in my earpiece. Ali was already on the other side, waving. Behind me I heard boots on metal. Two sets. Neither belonged to Grey Crow. I did not look back. I kept running.
across:1.cnHint: 我冲____桥面，耳机里的加密广播不停循环，身后传来两组脚步声。
across:1.hook: Ali's wave had turned into a warning before I reached her.
across:1.line: 'Get *across* now — they have a scanner and it is warm.'

sentences.en: The bridge was narrow and slick with rain.
sentences.cn: 桥很窄，被雨淋得湿漉漉的。

sentences.en: I ran *across* it without stopping, the encoded broadcast looping in my earpiece.
Ali was already on the other side, waving.
sentences.cn: 阿栗已经在另一边，挥手示意。

sentences.cn: 我身后传来了靴子踩在金属上的声音。

sentences.en: I did not look back.
sentences.cn: 我没有回头。

factor:1.en: Grey Crow spread a hand-drawn chart on the hood of a dead car. He circled one point in red. 'Weather is a *factor*,' he said, 'but not the main one.' He tapped the circle. 'The signal only opens when the crowd is thick enough to hide the source. We need people. Many people.'
factor:1.cnHint: 灰鸦解释说，天气只是一个____，真正关键的是人群的密度。
factor:1.hook: Zero's crew was already moving toward the crowd forming two blocks away.
factor:1.line: 'Weather is a *factor*, but the real one is standing right here.'

sentences.en: Grey Crow spread a hand-drawn chart on the hood of a dead car.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦在一辆死车的引擎盖上铺开了手绘图表。

He tapped the circle.
sentences.cn: 他点了一下这个圈。

condition:1.en: The tunnel entrance was sealed with a coded lock. Ali read the symbols fast. 'There is a *condition*,' she said, frowning. 'The lock opens only if the signal above ground is active.' We had no way to trigger the signal from down here. I looked at Grey Crow. He was already smiling.

condition:1.hook: Then the signal fired on its own, and nobody had touched anything.
condition:1.line: 'There is one *condition* — meet it wrong and the whole block goes dark.'

'The lock opens only if the signal above ground is active.'

effort:1.en: Every street in the old district looked the same at night — grey walls, broken lights, silence. But the coded graffiti was not random. I could see the *effort* now: each line placed at exact height, exact angle, forming a system. Someone patient and very careful had done this over years. Someone still alive.

effort:1.hook: One fresh mark at the corner had been painted within the last hour.
effort:1.line: 'Look at the *effort* in this — whoever did it is close, and watching.'

sentences.en: Every street in the old district looked the same at night — grey walls, broken lights, silence.
sentences.cn: 晚上老城区的每条街道看起来都一样——灰色的墙，坏掉的灯，寂静。

education:1.en: The old district's underground school met in a storm drain. Grey Crow handed me a cracked tablet. 'Your *education* starts here,' he said. The screen showed city codes, signal maps, hidden routes — knowledge the upper city had buried for thirty years. Rain hammered the iron grate above us.

education:1.hook: Then the tablet's screen flashed a name I recognised.
education:1.line: 'Your *education* starts here, and it will cost you sleep.'

scientist:1.en: A chalk outline circled the grate at Street Nine. Ali crouched low and read the symbol. 'This mark belongs to a *scientist* who disappeared six months ago,' she whispered. The city had announced he retired. The chalk was fresh. Someone wanted us to find this spot tonight, in the rain.

scientist:1.hook: Ali's hand trembled as she photographed the mark.
scientist:1.line: 'A *scientist* who disappears here never really retires.'

sentences.en: The chalk was fresh.

physical:1.en: Zero stood at the far end of the alley, still as stone. I had beaten him twice in code duels, but this felt different — a *physical* threat, not a digital one. He was bigger in person. The rain plastered his coat flat. Behind me, a dead end. No escape through the network this time.
physical:1.cnHint: 在小巷里，对手带来的不再是数字威胁，而是____上的危险。
physical:1.hook: He took one slow step forward and said nothing.
physical:1.line: 'This time the fight is *physical*, investigator — no keyboards.'

sentences.en: Zero stood at the far end of the alley, still as stone.

sentences.en: I had beaten him twice in code duels, but this felt different — a *physical* threat, not a digital one.
He was bigger in person.

sentences.en: The rain plastered his coat flat.
sentences.cn: 雨水把他的大衣贴在身上。

quality:1.en: Grey Crow passed me a signal chip no larger than a fingernail. 'The *quality* of this chip is why Zero wants it,' he said, turning up his collar against the rain. It could decode any encrypted broadcast in Harbor City within seconds. In the wrong hands it could silence every free voice overnight.

quality:1.hook: A shadow at the alley mouth told me we were already followed.
quality:1.line: 'The *quality* of this chip is what started the whole war.'

habit:1.en: Ali knew Zero's routines cold. 'His *habit* is to cross Neon Bridge at midnight, always alone,' she told me, scanning the wet street. I checked my watch: eleven forty. The bridge lights flickered orange through the downpour. If she was right, we had twenty minutes to set our trap and disappear.

habit:1.hook: Eleven fifty-eight — and the bridge lights went completely dark.
habit:1.line: 'His *habit* will betray him before any code ever does.'

I checked my watch: eleven forty.

sentences.en: My hands went cold.
sentences.cn: 我的双手冰冷刺骨。

rather:1.en: Rain hammered the old stone steps of the underpass. Ali pulled me aside before I could enter. 'The east tunnel is blocked,' she said. '*Rather* than fight through the guards, we circle north, through the market ruins.' I nodded. Every second we waited, the signal grew weaker.
rather:1.cnHint: 阿栗建议我们____绕道废弃市场，而不是硬闯东侧通道。
rather:1.hook: The north route passed directly under Zero's known territory.
rather:1.line: '*Rather* than charge in blind, let's take the long way round.'

sentences.en: Rain hammered the old stone steps of the underpass.
sentences.cn: 雨水猛烈地敲打着地下通道的破旧石阶。

sentences.en: Ali pulled me aside before I could enter.
sentences.cn: 我还没来得及进去，阿栗就把我拉到了一旁。

sentences.en: 'The east tunnel is blocked,' she said. '*Rather* than fight through the guards, we circle north, through the market ruins.'
I nodded.
sentences.cn: 我点了点头。

sentences.en: Every second we waited, the signal grew weaker.
sentences.cn: 我们等待的每一秒，信号都在变弱。

instead:1.en: I had planned to follow the main road down to the old port. But the signal shifted, pulling east *instead*, toward the crumbling factory block. I changed course without thinking. Ali called out behind me. Grey Crow was nowhere to be seen. The neon signs above buzzed and died one by one.
instead:1.cnHint: 信号突然向东偏移，我没有走原定路线，____拐向了废旧厂区。
instead:1.hook: Something, or someone, had rerouted the signal on purpose.
instead:1.line: 'Don't follow the road — cut through the yard *instead*.'

sentences.en: I had planned to follow the main road down to the old port.
sentences.cn: 我本打算沿着主干道一路下到老港口。

sentences.en: But the signal shifted, pulling east *instead*, toward the crumbling factory block.
I changed course without thinking.
sentences.cn: 我没有多想就改变了方向。

sentences.en: Ali called out behind me.
sentences.cn: 阿栗在我身后大声喊了一声。

sentences.en: Grey Crow was nowhere to be seen.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦消失得无影无踪。

sentences.en: The neon signs above buzzed and died one by one.
sentences.cn: 上方的霓虹灯招牌嗡嗡作响，一盏一盏地熄灭了。

performance:1.en: On the cracked plaza outside the old station, a street musician played a slow tune. No one stopped to listen. Grey Crow touched my shoulder. 'Watch the *performance*,' he said. 'The rhythm is a code. Count the pauses.' I counted. Three, one, four. A location. My pulse jumped.
performance:1.cnHint: 街头艺人的____暗藏密码，灰鸦让我仔细数节拍间隙。
performance:1.hook: The musician's eyes never moved, fixed on a point behind me.
performance:1.line: 'His *performance* is not music — it is a message in plain sight.'

sentences.en: On the cracked plaza outside the old station, a street musician played a slow tune.
sentences.cn: 在破旧车站外的裂纹广场上，一个街头音乐人在演奏缓慢的乐曲。

sentences.en: No one stopped to listen.
sentences.cn: 没有人停下来听。

sentences.en: Grey Crow touched my shoulder.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦碰了一下我的肩膀。

sentences.en: 'Watch the *performance*,' he said.
'The rhythm is a code.
sentences.cn: 节奏本身就是一套密码。

sentences.en: Count the pauses.'
sentences.cn: 数一下停顿的次数。

sentences.en: I counted.
sentences.cn: 我数了数。

sentences.en: Three, one, four.
sentences.cn: 三、一、四。

sentences.en: A location.
sentences.cn: 一个地点。

sentences.en: My pulse jumped.
sentences.cn: 我的脉搏跳得飞快。

percent:1.en: Ali checked the scanner and frowned. 'Signal strength is down to thirty *percent*,' she said, shaking the small device. 'We have maybe four minutes before it drops out completely.' Above us the rain-soaked billboard flickered. I pressed on, faster now, boots loud on wet stone. Time was already gone.
percent:1.cnHint: 阿栗报告信号强度只剩三十____，我们只有不到四分钟可以利用。
percent:1.hook: At zero percent, whoever was transmitting would vanish forever.
percent:1.line: 'Thirty *percent* left — we move now or we lose the signal.'

sentences.en: Ali checked the scanner and frowned.
sentences.cn: 阿栗检查了一下扫描仪，皱起了眉头。

sentences.en: 'Signal strength is down to thirty *percent*,' she said, shaking the small device.
'We have maybe four minutes before it drops out completely.'
sentences.cn: "我们最多还有四分钟信号就会完全消失。"

sentences.en: Above us the rain-soaked billboard flickered.
sentences.cn: 我们头顶的淋雨的广告牌闪烁着。

sentences.en: I pressed on, faster now, boots loud on wet stone.
sentences.cn: 我加快脚步，靴子在湿漉漉的石头上踏出沉重的回响。

sentences.en: Time was already gone.
sentences.cn: 时间已经没有了。

achieve:1.en: The old bridge was locked behind a coded gate. Zero's voice crackled over the open channel, cold and amused. 'You cannot *achieve* anything without the second key, investigator. And I have it.' I looked at the gate. Ali was already studying the lock with quiet, careful eyes. She smiled slightly.
achieve:1.cnHint: 零点嘲笑说，没有第二把密钥我们根本无法____目标，但阿栗已有了主意。
achieve:1.hook: Ali's smile meant she had found another way in.
achieve:1.line: 'You will never *achieve* your goal — not without what I hold.'

sentences.en: The old bridge was locked behind a coded gate.
sentences.cn: 老桥被一道密码门锁着。

sentences.en: Zero's voice crackled over the open channel, cold and amused.
sentences.cn: 零点的声音在开放频道上传来，冷漠而带着嘲讽。

sentences.en: 'You cannot *achieve* anything without the second key, investigator.
And I have it.'
sentences.cn: 而我拥有它。

sentences.en: I looked at the gate.
sentences.cn: 我看着那道门。

sentences.en: Ali was already studying the lock with quiet, careful eyes.
sentences.cn: 阿栗已经在用安静而谨慎的眼神研究那把锁了。

sentences.en: She smiled slightly.
sentences.cn: 她轻轻一笑。

challenge:1.en: Grey Crow stepped out of the shadow and faced the two guards blocking the side street. He raised one hand, calm and deliberate. 'I *challenge* your right to hold this passage,' he said. 'Under old city law, this road is open.' The guards looked at each other. I slipped past them unseen.
challenge:1.cnHint: 灰鸦当众____守卫封路的权力，为我争取了溜过去的机会。
challenge:1.hook: Old city law had not been spoken aloud here in thirty years.
challenge:1.line: 'I *challenge* your right to close this road to the public.'

sentences.en: Grey Crow stepped out of the shadow and faced the two guards blocking the side street.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦从阴影里走了出来，面对堵住小街的两个警卫。

sentences.en: He raised one hand, calm and deliberate.
sentences.cn: 他举起一只手，冷静而坚决。

sentences.en: 'I *challenge* your right to hold this passage,' he said.
'Under old city law, this road is open.'
sentences.cn: 根据老城法律，这条路是开放的。

sentences.en: The guards looked at each other.
sentences.cn: 两个警卫互相对视了一眼。

sentences.en: I slipped past them unseen.
sentences.cn: 我趁机从他们身边溜了过去。

power:1.en: The street lights died all at once. Every screen, every sign, every humming cable went silent. Ali grabbed my arm. 'Grid *power* is out across the whole old district,' she said. 'This is not an accident.' In the sudden dark, I heard footsteps — slow, deliberate, coming from above. Then a low laugh.
power:1.cnHint: 整个旧城区突然断____，阿栗断定这绝非意外，黑暗中传来脚步声。
power:1.hook: In darkness, whoever controlled the grid controlled everything.
power:1.line: 'The *power* is gone — and someone cut it just for us.'

sentences.en: The street lights died all at once.
sentences.cn: 街灯一下子全都灭了。

sentences.en: Every screen, every sign, every humming cable went silent.
sentences.cn: 每块屏幕、每个招牌、每根嗡嗡作响的电缆都沉寂了下来。

sentences.en: Ali grabbed my arm.
sentences.cn: 阿栗抓住了我的手臂。

sentences.en: 'Grid *power* is out across the whole old district,' she said.
'This is not an accident.'
sentences.cn: 这不是意外。

sentences.en: In the sudden dark, I heard footsteps — slow, deliberate, coming from above.
sentences.cn: 在突然的黑暗中，我听到了脚步声——缓慢、有意的，从上方传来。

sentences.en: Then a low laugh.
sentences.cn: 然后是一声低沉的笑声。

key:1.en: Rain hammered the cracked pavement of Old Town's lower streets. Grey Crow pressed a small metal object into my hand. 'This is the *key*,' he said, eyes fixed on the sealed door ahead. Without it, the underground signal would stay silent forever. I felt its cold weight and understood everything.
key:1.cnHint: 灰鸦将一件重要的东西交给我，它能打开地下信号的秘密。____是解开一切的关键。
key:1.hook: But the door had already been opened from the inside.
key:1.line: 'This *key* opens more than a door — it opens the truth.'

sentences.en: Rain hammered the cracked pavement of Old Town's lower streets.
sentences.cn: 雨水猛烈地砸在老城下街的破裂人行道上。

sentences.en: Grey Crow pressed a small metal object into my hand.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦把一个小金属物体塞进我的手里。

sentences.en: 'This is the *key*,' he said, eyes fixed on the sealed door ahead.
Without it, the underground signal would stay silent forever.
sentences.cn: 没有它，地下信号就会永远保持沉默。

sentences.en: I felt its cold weight and understood everything.
sentences.cn: 我感受到它冰冷的重量，一切都明白了。

issue:1.en: Old Town's walls were covered in coded graffiti. Ali pointed at a torn paper sheet nailed to a lamppost. It was a street *issue* of the underground press, printed on rough grey paper. Three words were circled in red ink. I read them once. My hands went cold.
issue:1.cnHint: 阿栗发现了一份地下印刷的____，上面有三个被圈出的红字。
issue:1.hook: Those three words were my own name.
issue:1.line: 'This *issue* has been banned since midnight — someone wants it found.'

sentences.en: Old Town's walls were covered in coded graffiti.
sentences.cn: 旧城的墙上满是密码涂鸦。

sentences.en: Ali pointed at a torn paper sheet nailed to a lamppost.
sentences.cn: 阿栗指向钉在路灯柱上的一张撕破的纸片。

sentences.en: It was a street *issue* of the underground press, printed on rough grey paper.
Three words were circled in red ink.
sentences.cn: 三个单词被红墨水圈起来。

sentences.en: I read them once.
sentences.cn: 我读了一遍。

sentences.en: My hands went cold.
sentences.cn: 我的手冰冷了下去。

against:1.en: I flattened my back *against* the wet stone wall as boots echoed around the corner. Zero's patrol moved slow and steady through the fog. One wrong sound and it was over. Ali grabbed my sleeve and pointed up — a ladder, half-hidden by shadow, four metres above us.
against:1.cnHint: 我紧靠着墙壁躲避零点的巡逻队，阿栗发现了一条逃脱的路。
against:1.hook: The ladder creaked — someone was already climbing down.
against:1.line: 'Stay *against* the wall and do not breathe until they pass.'

sentences.en: I flattened my back *against* the wet stone wall as boots echoed around the corner.
Zero's patrol moved slow and steady through the fog.
sentences.cn: 零点的巡逻队在雾气中缓缓移动。

sentences.en: One wrong sound and it was over.
sentences.cn: 一个声音出错就完了。

sentences.en: Ali grabbed my sleeve and pointed up — a ladder, half-hidden by shadow, four metres above us.
sentences.cn: 阿栗拽了拽我的袖子，指向上方——一架梯子，半隐在阴影里，离我们四米高。

matter:1.en: Grey Crow stopped at the centre of a flooded square. He turned to me, voice flat. 'This is not a small *matter*,' he said. 'The signal hidden under this street could bring down the entire city network.' Water rose around our ankles. Somewhere below, a machine was humming.
matter:1.cnHint: 灰鸦告诉我，藏在街道下方的信号绝非小____，它关系到整个城市网络。
matter:1.hook: Then the humming stopped, and silence pressed down like a fist.
matter:1.line: 'It does not *matter* who sent it — it matters what it says.'

sentences.en: Grey Crow stopped at the centre of a flooded square.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦停在了一个积水的广场中心。

sentences.en: He turned to me, voice flat.
sentences.cn: 他转向我，声音平板。

sentences.en: 'This is not a small *matter*,' he said.
'The signal hidden under this street could bring down the entire city network.'
sentences.cn: 藏在这条街下面的信号能摧毁整个城市网络。

sentences.en: Water rose around our ankles.
sentences.cn: 水位漫过了我们的脚踝。

sentences.en: Somewhere below, a machine was humming.
sentences.cn: 下面某处，一台机器在嗡嗡声。

raise:1.en: Ali crouched beside the iron grate and began to *raise* it with both hands, teeth clenched against the weight. Below was darkness and the smell of old circuits. Grey Crow kept watch at the corner. I counted seconds. The grate lifted. A faint blue light pulsed from below.
raise:1.cnHint: 阿栗用力____开铁栅栏，下方传来微弱的蓝光。
raise:1.hook: A hand reached up from the darkness before we could move.
raise:1.line: '*Raise* it slowly — the sensors will trigger if it shifts too fast.'

sentences.en: Ali crouched beside the iron grate and began to *raise* it with both hands, teeth clenched against the weight.
Below was darkness and the smell of old circuits.
sentences.cn: 下面是黑暗和陈旧电路的味道。

sentences.en: Grey Crow kept watch at the corner.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦守在角落。

sentences.en: I counted seconds.
sentences.cn: 我数着秒数。

sentences.en: The grate lifted.
sentences.cn: 栅栏被撬开了。

sentences.en: A faint blue light pulsed from below.
sentences.cn: 一束微弱的蓝光从下面脉冲般闪烁。

option:1.en: Zero's voice cut through the rain from a speaker bolted to the wall. 'You have one *option*,' it said, cold and even. 'Leave the district before the clock tower strikes. After that, I cannot promise your safety.' Grey Crow did not flinch. He looked at me and shook his head once.
option:1.cnHint: 零点通过广播告知我们只有一个____，灰鸦却摇头拒绝。
option:1.hook: Grey Crow pulled out a second device I had never seen before.
option:1.line: 'There is always another *option* — Zero just does not want you to see it.'

sentences.en: Zero's voice cut through the rain from a speaker bolted to the wall.
sentences.cn: 零点的声音从钉在墙上的扬声器里划破雨声传来。

sentences.en: 'You have one *option*,' it said, cold and even.
'Leave the district before the clock tower strikes.
sentences.cn: 在时钟塔敲响之前离开这个街区。

sentences.en: After that, I cannot promise your safety.'
sentences.cn: 之后，我无法保证你的安全。

sentences.en: Grey Crow did not flinch.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦没有退缩。

sentences.en: He looked at me and shook his head once.
sentences.cn: 他看向我，摇了一次头。

society:1.en: Painted high on the bridge wall were three interlocked circles — the mark of the underground *society* that had been running coded signals for twenty years. Grey Crow traced the symbol with one finger. 'They built this city's real nervous system,' he said quietly. Ali looked both ways and said nothing.
society:1.cnHint: 桥墙上的三个圆圈是一个地下____的标志，他们掌控着城市真正的信息网络。
society:1.hook: Below the symbol, fresh paint spelled out a single warning: LEAVE NOW.
society:1.line: 'That *society* has ears in every wall of Old Town — choose your words.'

sentences.en: Painted high on the bridge wall were three interlocked circles — the mark of the underground *society* that had been running coded signals for twenty years.
Grey Crow traced the symbol with one finger.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦用一根手指描过这个符号。

sentences.en: 'They built this city's real nervous system,' he said quietly.
sentences.cn: 他轻声说，他们建造了这座城市真正的神经系统。

sentences.en: Ali looked both ways and said nothing.
sentences.cn: 阿栗左右看了看，什么都没说。

whole:1.en: I stood at the edge of Old Town and looked back. Every neon sign, every cracked window, every flooded lane was connected. Grey Crow had said it once, and now I felt it: the *whole* district was one giant antenna, broadcasting a signal no one above ground could decode. No one except me.
whole:1.cnHint: 我意识到旧城____就是一座巨大的天线，只有我能解读它发出的信号。
whole:1.hook: My receiver buzzed once, then spelled out two letters: Z — O.
whole:1.line: 'The *whole* map only makes sense when you stand in the right place.'

sentences.en: I stood at the edge of Old Town and looked back.
sentences.cn: 我站在旧城边缘，回头看。

sentences.en: Every neon sign, every cracked window, every flooded lane was connected.
sentences.cn: 每一盏霓虹灯，每一扇破裂的窗户，每一条积水的小巷都连接在一起。

sentences.en: Grey Crow had said it once, and now I felt it: the *whole* district was one giant antenna, broadcasting a signal no one above ground could decode.
No one except me.
sentences.cn: 除了我没有别人。

receive:1.en: Rain hammered the old district streets. I pressed against a cold wall and watched a courier drone drop a sealed package at my feet. Moments later my wrist-comm buzzed — I had just *received* a message with no sender ID. Three words: 'Open it now.'
receive:1.cnHint: 调查员在街头____了一条来源不明的神秘信息。
receive:1.line: 'You *received* it — that means they already know where you are.'

sentences.en: Rain hammered the old district streets.
sentences.cn: 雨砸打着老街区的街道。

sentences.en: I pressed against a cold wall and watched a courier drone drop a sealed package at my feet.
sentences.cn: 我紧贴着冰冷的墙，看着一架信使无人机在我脚下放下了一个密封的包裹。

sentences.en: Moments later my wrist-comm buzzed — I had just *received* a message with no sender ID.
Three words: 'Open it now.'
sentences.cn: 三个单词："现在打开。"

encourage:1.en: Grey Crow stood at the mouth of the alley, rain soaking his coat. The city scanner drones swept overhead. I hesitated. He turned, looked straight at me, and gave one slow nod — the kind meant to *encourage* someone who is about to do something they cannot undo.
encourage:1.cnHint: 引路人用一个眼神____了犹豫不决的调查员。
encourage:1.hook: Then Grey Crow stepped into the light and vanished.
encourage:1.line: 'I *encourage* you to move — right now, before the second sweep.'

sentences.en: Grey Crow stood at the mouth of the alley, rain soaking his coat.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦站在小巷的入口，雨水浸透了他的外套。

sentences.en: The city scanner drones swept overhead.
sentences.cn: 城市扫描无人机从头顶扫过。

sentences.en: I hesitated.
sentences.cn: 我犹豫了。

sentences.en: He turned, looked straight at me, and gave one slow nod — the kind meant to *encourage* someone who is about to do something they cannot undo.

travel:1.en: In 2099 you never *travel* the old district streets on foot without checking the signal map first. I ignored that rule. Two blocks in, every public screen around me lit up with my face. Ali's voice crackled in my ear: 'Wrong road, rookie.'
travel:1.cnHint: 调查员在旧城街道____时，发现自己的脸出现在了所有公共屏幕上。
travel:1.hook: The signal map showed I was already surrounded.
travel:1.line: 'When you *travel* these streets, the streets remember you.'

sentences.en: In 2099 you never *travel* the old district streets on foot without checking the signal map first.
I ignored that rule.
sentences.cn: 我忽略了那条规则。

sentences.en: Two blocks in, every public screen around me lit up with my face.
sentences.cn: 进去两个街区，我周围所有的公共屏幕都亮起了我的脸。

sentences.en: Ali's voice crackled in my ear: 'Wrong road, rookie.'
sentences.cn: 阿栗的声音在我耳朵里噼啪作响："走错路了，菜鸟。"

strong:1.en: The old bridge at Canal Nine was supposed to be sealed. I found the lock cut clean. Below, the current ran black and fast. The smell of burned wire was *strong* enough to sting my eyes — someone had shorted the security grid here very recently.
strong:1.cnHint: 调查员在运河桥发现____的焦线气味，意识到有人刚刚破坏了安全系统。
strong:1.hook: A shadow moved under the bridge, against the current.
strong:1.line: 'That smell is *strong* — the grid went down less than ten minutes ago.'

sentences.en: The old bridge at Canal Nine was supposed to be sealed.
sentences.cn: 九号运河上的老桥本应被封闭。

sentences.en: I found the lock cut clean.
sentences.cn: 我发现锁被整齐地切断了。

sentences.en: Below, the current ran black and fast.
sentences.cn: 下面，水流黑暗而湍急。

sentences.en: The smell of burned wire was *strong* enough to sting my eyes — someone had shorted the security grid here very recently.

chance:1.en: Zero appeared from behind a news kiosk, hands open, almost friendly. 'One *chance*,' he said quietly. 'Tell me who sent you and I walk away.' The rain filled the silence between us. Every exit was covered. I weighed the odds and did not like them.
chance:1.cnHint: 对手给了调查员一次____，要求说出幕后指使者。
chance:1.hook: My hand moved toward the pocket that held nothing useful.
chance:1.line: 'This is your one *chance* — and it expires in five seconds.'

sentences.en: Zero appeared from behind a news kiosk, hands open, almost friendly.
sentences.cn: 零点从新闻亭后面现身，双手张开，几乎很友好。

sentences.en: 'One *chance*,' he said quietly.
'Tell me who sent you and I walk away.'
sentences.cn: 告诉我是谁派你来的，我就走开。

sentences.en: The rain filled the silence between us.
sentences.cn: 雨填满了我们之间的沉默。

sentences.en: Every exit was covered.
sentences.cn: 每条出口都被守住了。

sentences.en: I weighed the odds and did not like them.
sentences.cn: 我权衡了一下赔率，不太喜欢结果。

solve:1.en: Ali spread the stolen transit maps across a wet crate in the open yard. 'Look at the gaps,' she said. Three routes, each one blocked the same way, on the same night each month. If I could *solve* the pattern, I would know where the next drop was.
solve:1.cnHint: 阿栗和调查员试图____地图上隐藏的规律，找出下一个秘密交接地点。
solve:1.hook: The gaps in the map spelled a name neither of us wanted to say.
solve:1.line: '*Solve* the pattern and we own the next move — not them.'

sentences.en: Ali spread the stolen transit maps across a wet crate in the open yard.
sentences.cn: 阿栗把偷来的地铁线路图铺展在开放式院子里的一个湿漉漉的板条箱上。

sentences.en: 'Look at the gaps,' she said.
sentences.cn: "看看这些空白，"她说。

sentences.en: Three routes, each one blocked the same way, on the same night each month.
sentences.cn: 三条路线，每条都以同样的方式受阻，每个月的同一晚。

sentences.en: If I could *solve* the pattern, I would know where the next drop was.

quite:1.en: The neon above the old market was *quite* dim compared to the upper city — just enough light to see faces, not enough to record them clearly. That was the point. Grey Crow had chosen this corner for a reason. Everyone here was hiding something small or something enormous.
quite:1.cnHint: 旧市场的灯光____暗淡，调查员意识到这个角落是藏匿秘密的理想之地。
quite:1.hook: Grey Crow was watching someone I had not noticed yet.
quite:1.line: 'It is *quite* dark here — which means the cameras are blind.'

sentences.en: The neon above the old market was *quite* dim compared to the upper city — just enough light to see faces, not enough to record them clearly.
That was the point.
sentences.cn: 这就是意义所在。

sentences.en: Grey Crow had chosen this corner for a reason.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦选择这个角落是有原因的。

sentences.en: Everyone here was hiding something small or something enormous.
sentences.cn: 这里的每个人都隐藏着什么——要么是小秘密，要么是滔天大事。

technology:1.en: The underground station wall was covered in coded graffiti, but one patch looked different — clean lines, no spray. Ali ran her finger along it. 'This isn't art,' she said. 'This is *technology*.' The marks were a signal antenna, painted in conductive ink, broadcasting on a frequency the city did not monitor.
technology:1.cnHint: 阿栗发现涂鸦墙上隐藏着一种特殊的____，正在向未被监控的频段发送信号。
technology:1.hook: Someone was already listening on the other end.
technology:1.line: 'Call it graffiti if you like — I call it *technology*.'

sentences.en: The underground station wall was covered in coded graffiti, but one patch looked different — clean lines, no spray.
sentences.cn: 地下车站的墙壁上覆盖着密码涂鸦，但其中一块看起来不同——线条干净，没有喷漆。

sentences.en: Ali ran her finger along it.
sentences.cn: 阿栗用手指沿着它滑过。

sentences.en: 'This isn't art,' she said.
sentences.cn: "这不是艺术，"她说。

sentences.en: 'This is *technology*.'
The marks were a signal antenna, painted in conductive ink, broadcasting on a frequency the city did not monitor.
sentences.cn: 那些标记是一根信号天线，用导电墨水绘制，在这座城市不监控的频率上广播。

nearly:1.en: The coded graffiti covered the underpass wall from end to end. I *nearly* missed the small arrow hidden inside the third symbol — the one pointing straight down. Grey Crow had warned me: the old city hides its secrets in plain sight. I crouched low and pressed my ear to the wet concrete.
nearly:1.cnHint: 我____错过了涂鸦中那个隐藏的箭头符号。
nearly:1.hook: Something below the street was breathing.
nearly:1.line: 'I *nearly* walked past it — good thing you trained my eyes,' I told Grey Crow.

sentences.en: The coded graffiti covered the underpass wall from end to end.
sentences.cn: 密码涂鸦从隧道的一端覆盖到另一端。

sentences.en: I *nearly* missed the small arrow hidden inside the third symbol — the one pointing straight down.
Grey Crow had warned me: the old city hides its secrets in plain sight.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦曾警告我：古城在光天化日之下隐藏它的秘密。

sentences.en: I crouched low and pressed my ear to the wet concrete.
sentences.cn: 我蜷身靠近，把耳朵贴在潮湿的混凝土上。

wrong:1.en: Ali pulled up the signal map on her worn device and pointed at a blinking node near the old water tower. 'That reading is *wrong*,' she said flatly. Every other node pulsed in a steady rhythm, but this one skipped every fourth beat — a pattern too neat to be a fault, too odd to ignore.
wrong:1.cnHint: 阿栗发现地图上有一个____的信号节点，节奏异常。
wrong:1.hook: Someone had edited that node on purpose.
wrong:1.line: 'The data is *wrong*, and whoever changed it is still close,' Ali said.

sentences.en: Ali pulled up the signal map on her worn device and pointed at a blinking node near the old water tower.
sentences.cn: 阿栗在她破旧的设备上调出信号地图，指向靠近老水塔的闪烁节点。

sentences.en: 'That reading is *wrong*,' she said flatly.
Every other node pulsed in a steady rhythm, but this one skipped every fourth beat — a pattern too neat to be a fault, too odd to ignore.
sentences.cn: 每个其他节点都以稳定的节奏跳动，但这一个每四拍就跳过一下——一种过于整洁的规律，太奇怪而不能忽视。

variety:1.en: The street market below the elevated rail sold a *variety* of cheap signal scramblers — little boxes, flat discs, devices shaped like coins. I moved through the stalls slowly, watching hands more than goods. One vendor met my eyes for exactly one second too long, then looked away. That was enough.
variety:1.cnHint: 我在旧城集市上看到各种各样的信号干扰器，其中一个摊主引起了我的注意。
variety:1.hook: The coin-shaped device was already gone from his table.
variety:1.line: 'A *variety* of fakes — but one of these is very real,' Grey Crow murmured.

sentences.en: The street market below the elevated rail sold a *variety* of cheap signal scramblers — little boxes, flat discs, devices shaped like coins.
I moved through the stalls slowly, watching hands more than goods.
sentences.cn: 我缓缓穿过摊位，看的是手而不是商品。

sentences.en: One vendor met my eyes for exactly one second too long, then looked away.
sentences.cn: 一个摊主的目光和我相遇了整整一秒多，然后转开了。

sentences.en: That was enough.
sentences.cn: 那就够了。

clear:1.en: Rain had washed the chalk marks off the stone steps, but the deeper scratch beneath them was still *clear* — three short lines and a circle, the symbol Zero used when a drop was made. I photographed it fast. Somewhere above me, a shutter clicked. I was not alone on this street.
clear:1.cnHint: 雨水冲掉了粉笔痕迹，但石阶上更深的刻痕依然____可见。
clear:1.hook: The shutter clicked a second time, much closer.
clear:1.line: 'The mark is *clear* — Zero was here within the last hour,' I said.

sentences.en: Rain had washed the chalk marks off the stone steps, but the deeper scratch beneath them was still *clear* — three short lines and a circle, the symbol Zero used when a drop was made.
I photographed it fast.
sentences.cn: 我拍得很快。

sentences.en: Somewhere above me, a shutter clicked.
sentences.cn: 在我上方的某处，快门声响起。

sentences.en: I was not alone on this street.
sentences.cn: 我不是这条街上的唯一一个人。

gain:1.en: Grey Crow appeared at the corner, collar up against the rain. He handed me a folded slip without slowing his pace. 'Small *gain* tonight,' he said quietly. The slip held a six-digit frequency. It was not much — just one number — but in Harbor City a single frequency could unlock a whole hidden network.
gain:1.cnHint: 灰鸦悄悄递给我一张纸条，说今晚的____不算多。
gain:1.hook: The frequency matched the one burned into Zero's last message.
gain:1.line: 'A small *gain*, but enough to find the next door,' Grey Crow said.

sentences.en: Grey Crow appeared at the corner, collar up against the rain.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦出现在拐角处，竖起衣领抵挡雨水。

sentences.en: He handed me a folded slip without slowing his pace.
sentences.cn: 他没有放慢脚步就递给我一张折叠的纸条。

sentences.en: 'Small *gain* tonight,' he said quietly.
The slip held a six-digit frequency.
sentences.cn: 纸条上写着一个六位数的频率。

sentences.en: It was not much — just one number — but in Harbor City a single frequency could unlock a whole hidden network.
sentences.cn: 这不算太多——只是一个数字——但在港城，一个频率就能打开整个隐藏网络。

huge:1.en: We reached the old freight yard at the edge of the underground quarter. A *huge* rusted container, four times the height of a man, stood apart from the rest, padlocked with a modern seal that had no business being on a thirty-year-old box. Ali scanned the seal. Her device went silent. That was a bad sign.
huge:1.cnHint: 货场里一个巨大的集装箱上锁着一把与它年代完全不符的新锁。
huge:1.hook: The seal was still warm, as if just touched.
huge:1.line: 'That *huge* box is the only one with a new lock — start there,' Ali said.

sentences.en: We reached the old freight yard at the edge of the underground quarter.
sentences.cn: 我们到达了地下区边缘的旧货运车场。

sentences.en: A *huge* rusted container, four times the height of a man, stood apart from the rest, padlocked with a modern seal that had no business being on a thirty-year-old box.
Ali scanned the seal.
sentences.cn: 阿栗扫描了封条。

sentences.en: Her device went silent.
sentences.cn: 她的设备沉默了。

sentences.en: That was a bad sign.
sentences.cn: 那是个坏信号。

diet:1.en: The night-shift vendor near the tunnel entrance sold a narrow *diet* of food: grey rice, canned protein, bitter tea. Nothing that needed cold storage. Nothing that would spoil if the power cut out — which it did, every night, at exactly two in the morning. Zero had chosen this spot well. I ordered the tea and waited.
diet:1.cnHint: 隧道口的小摊只提供种类单一的____，零点选择这个地点显然是经过深思的。
diet:1.hook: At two the lights died, and a hand touched my shoulder.
diet:1.line: 'A plain *diet* keeps you sharp — that is what Zero always said,' Grey Crow told me.

sentences.en: The night-shift vendor near the tunnel entrance sold a narrow *diet* of food: grey rice, canned protein, bitter tea.
Nothing that needed cold storage.
sentences.cn: 没有什么需要冷藏。

sentences.en: Nothing that would spoil if the power cut out — which it did, every night, at exactly two in the morning.
sentences.cn: 没有什么会在断电时变质——这种情况每晚都发生，恰好在早上两点。

sentences.en: Zero had chosen this spot well.
sentences.cn: 零点选得这个地方真不错。

sentences.en: I ordered the tea and waited.
sentences.cn: 我点了茶，等待。

animal:1.en: Rain hammered the old district streets. I spotted Grey Crow crouched near a storm drain, watching a stray cat pick through broken glass. 'Every *animal* in Harbor City learns to survive the hard way,' he said. The cat froze, ears flat. Then I heard what it heard — boots on wet stone, coming fast.
animal:1.cnHint: 引路人蹲在排水沟旁，观察一只流浪猫，提醒我这座城市里每个____都学会了艰难求生。
animal:1.hook: The boots stopped. Someone was listening to us.
animal:1.line: 'Every *animal* in Harbor City learns to survive the hard way.'

sentences.en: Rain hammered the old district streets.
sentences.cn: 雨敲打着老街区的街道。

sentences.en: I spotted Grey Crow crouched near a storm drain, watching a stray cat pick through broken glass.
sentences.cn: 我发现灰鸦蜷伏在风暴下水道旁，看着一只野猫在碎玻璃中翻找。

sentences.en: 'Every *animal* in Harbor City learns to survive the hard way,' he said.
The cat froze, ears flat.
sentences.cn: 那只猫僵住了，耳朵贴平。

sentences.en: Then I heard what it heard — boots on wet stone, coming fast.
sentences.cn: 然后我听到了它听到的——靴子踩在湿石头上的声音，快速靠近。

goal:1.en: Zero's voice cut through the static on my earpiece: 'Your *goal* tonight is simple — reach the signal tower before the clock hits midnight.' I looked up at the crumbling tower three blocks away. Neon light painted it red. Ali grabbed my sleeve. 'Simple,' she muttered. 'Sure.'
goal:1.cnHint: 零点通过耳机告诉我，今晚的____很简单——在午夜前抵达信号塔。
goal:1.hook: The tower lights died. All of them, at once.
goal:1.line: 'Your *goal* tonight is simple — reach the tower before midnight.'

sentences.en: Zero's voice cut through the static on my earpiece: 'Your *goal* tonight is simple — reach the signal tower before the clock hits midnight.'
I looked up at the crumbling tower three blocks away.
sentences.cn: 我抬头看着三个街区外破烂的塔楼。

sentences.en: Neon light painted it red.
sentences.cn: 霓虹灯把它照成了红色。

sentences.en: Ali grabbed my sleeve.
sentences.cn: 阿栗抓住我的袖子。

sentences.en: 'Simple,' she muttered.
sentences.cn: "简单，"她喃喃自语。

sentences.en: 'Sure.'
sentences.cn: "当然。"

adult:1.en: The checkpoint guard looked me over. No one under twenty could pass through the old district after dark — city rule. 'You an *adult*?' he asked, eyes flat. I slid my card across the wet counter. He studied it too long. Behind him, a door I had not noticed before swung open by itself.
adult:1.cnHint: 检查站的警卫质疑我是否是____，我把证件递了过去，他盯着看了太久。
adult:1.hook: The door behind him swung open — no one pushed it.
adult:1.line: 'You an *adult*?' he asked, eyes flat on my face.

sentences.en: The checkpoint guard looked me over.
sentences.cn: 检查站的卫兵上下打量了我一番。

sentences.en: No one under twenty could pass through the old district after dark — city rule.
sentences.cn: 天黑后，二十岁以下的人禁止进入老城区——这是城市的规定。

sentences.en: 'You an *adult*?' he asked, eyes flat.
I slid my card across the wet counter.
sentences.cn: 我把卡片滑过湿漉漉的柜台。

sentences.en: He studied it too long.
sentences.cn: 他盯着卡片看得太久了。

sentences.en: Behind him, a door I had not noticed before swung open by itself.
sentences.cn: 他身后，一扇我之前没注意到的门自己打开了。

poor:1.en: Ali knelt beside the old vendor slumped against the market wall, his cart of paper maps knocked over, coins scattered in the rain. '*Poor* man,' she whispered. I noticed his hand — it was gripping something under his coat. Not a wound. A receiver. The vendor was no random stranger.
poor:1.cnHint: 阿栗在市场墙边发现一个倒地的摊贩，低声说他真____，我却注意到他手里藏着什么。
poor:1.hook: His eyes opened. He had been waiting for us.
poor:1.line: '*Poor* man,' Ali whispered, kneeling in the rain.

sentences.en: Ali knelt beside the old vendor slumped against the market wall, his cart of paper maps knocked over, coins scattered in the rain. '*Poor* man,' she whispered.
I noticed his hand — it was gripping something under his coat.
sentences.cn: 我注意到他的手——在外套下紧紧攥着什么东西。

sentences.en: Not a wound.
sentences.cn: 不是伤口。

sentences.en: A receiver.
sentences.cn: 是一个接收器。

sentences.en: The vendor was no random stranger.
sentences.cn: 这个小贩不是什么陌生人。

price:1.en: Grey Crow spread a cracked map on the hood of a dead car. 'This route is fast,' he said, 'but there is a *price* — the corridor is watched by Zero's people.' Every other path added two hours we did not have. I traced the danger zone with one finger and made the only call I could.
price:1.cnHint: 引路人指出最快的路线，但警告我要走这条路是有____的——零点的人在那里监视。
price:1.hook: My finger stopped. A fresh mark — someone had updated this map tonight.
price:1.line: 'Fast route, yes — but there is a *price* for using it.'

sentences.en: Grey Crow spread a cracked map on the hood of a dead car.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦把一张裂纹斑驳的地图铺在一辆废弃汽车的引擎盖上。

sentences.en: 'This route is fast,' he said, 'but there is a *price* — the corridor is watched by Zero's people.'
Every other path added two hours we did not have.
sentences.cn: 其他每条路都要多花两小时，而我们根本没有。

sentences.en: I traced the danger zone with one finger and made the only call I could.
sentences.cn: 我用一根手指沿着危险区域描过，做出了唯一能做的选择。

type:1.en: Ali pressed a stolen keycard into my palm. 'Wrong *type*,' I said at once — the chip colour was blue, and every door in this sector needed green. She smiled and flipped it over. The other side was green. A double card. I had never seen one before, and that made me more afraid, not less.
type:1.cnHint: 阿栗递给我一张偷来的门卡，我说____不对，她翻转过来，露出另一面。
type:1.hook: Double cards only exist if someone inside made them.
type:1.line: 'Wrong *type*,' I said, staring at the blue chip.

sentences.en: Ali pressed a stolen keycard into my palm.
sentences.cn: 阿栗把偷来的钥匙卡塞进我的手心。

sentences.en: 'Wrong *type*,' I said at once — the chip colour was blue, and every door in this sector needed green.
She smiled and flipped it over.
sentences.cn: 她笑着翻过卡片。

sentences.en: The other side was green.
sentences.cn: 另一面是绿色的。

sentences.en: A double card.
sentences.cn: 一张双面卡。

sentences.en: I had never seen one before, and that made me more afraid, not less.
sentences.cn: 我从未见过这样的东西，这反而让我更加害怕，而不是放心。

sense:1.en: The old district smelled of rust and burnt cable. I stopped walking. Something was off — a *sense* I had learned to trust since the day Grey Crow first trained me. No wind, no rats, no hum from the power lines above. Silence in Harbor City was never natural. I clicked off my torch.
sense:1.cnHint: 旧城区气味异常，我停下脚步，凭借一种____察觉到情况不对，于是关掉了手电筒。
sense:1.hook: In the dark, something exhaled — close, very close.
sense:1.line: 'Trust that *sense*. It has kept me alive for years.'

sentences.en: The old district smelled of rust and burnt cable.
sentences.cn: 老城区闻起来像生锈和烧焦电缆的味道。

sentences.en: I stopped walking.
sentences.cn: 我停下了脚步。

sentences.en: Something was off — a *sense* I had learned to trust since the day Grey Crow first trained me.
No wind, no rats, no hum from the power lines above.
sentences.cn: 没有风，没有老鼠，没有头顶电线的嗡鸣声。

sentences.en: Silence in Harbor City was never natural.
sentences.cn: 港口城的寂静从来都不自然。

sentences.en: I clicked off my torch.
sentences.cn: 我关掉了手电筒。

rate:1.en: 'Signal decay *rate* is climbing,' Ali said, eyes locked on her small screen. Numbers scrolled fast — forty percent, sixty, seventy-two. At one hundred the broadcast would vanish and our one lead would be gone. We had maybe four minutes. I looked down the rain-slicked alley and started running.
rate:1.cnHint: 阿栗盯着屏幕，报告信号衰减的____在迅速攀升，我们只剩大约四分钟。
rate:1.hook: At eighty-nine percent, the screen cracked.
rate:1.line: 'Signal decay *rate* is climbing — we have four minutes, maybe.'

sentences.en: 'Signal decay *rate* is climbing,' Ali said, eyes locked on her small screen.
Numbers scrolled fast — forty percent, sixty, seventy-two.
sentences.cn: 数字快速滚动——百分之四十、六十、七十二。

sentences.en: At one hundred the broadcast would vanish and our one lead would be gone.
sentences.cn: 到了百分之百，广播就会消失，我们唯一的线索也就没了。

sentences.en: We had maybe four minutes.
sentences.cn: 我们也许还有四分钟。

sentences.en: I looked down the rain-slicked alley and started running.
sentences.cn: 我看着雨水打湿的小巷，开始奔跑。

action:1.en: The coded graffiti covered the old bridge wall. Grey Crow pressed a finger to the wet paint and whispered, 'They moved last night.' Every *action* here left a trace, even in the rain. I scanned the marks and felt a cold signal rise behind my eyes.
action:1.cnHint: 旧桥墙上的密语涂鸦让叙述者感到，这里的每一个____都留下了痕迹。
action:1.hook: The trace led somewhere I was not meant to go.
action:1.line: 'Every *action* leaves a mark, even in the rain.'

sentences.en: The coded graffiti covered the old bridge wall.
sentences.cn: 编码的涂鸦覆盖了老桥的墙面。

sentences.en: Grey Crow pressed a finger to the wet paint and whispered, 'They moved last night.'
sentences.cn: 灰鸦用手指按在湿漉漉的油漆上，低声说，"他们昨晚转移了。"

sentences.en: Every *action* here left a trace, even in the rain.
I scanned the marks and felt a cold signal rise behind my eyes.
sentences.cn: 我扫过这些标记，感觉一股冷冰冰的信号在我眼后升起。

program:1.en: A cracked screen on the alley wall ran a looping *program*, flashing numbers no one else could read. I stopped. The sequence was a message — one Grey Crow had warned me about. Ali grabbed my sleeve. 'Keep walking,' she said. 'Reading it means they see you back.'
program:1.cnHint: 巷子里的破屏幕上有一段____在循环播放，叙述者意识到这是一条危险讯息。
program:1.hook: The screen flickered once, then locked onto my eyes.
program:1.line: 'That *program* is not a broadcast — it is a trap.'

sentences.en: A cracked screen on the alley wall ran a looping *program*, flashing numbers no one else could read.
I stopped.
sentences.cn: 我停了下来。

sentences.en: The sequence was a message — one Grey Crow had warned me about.
sentences.cn: 这个序列是一条讯息——灰鸦曾经警告过我的那种。

sentences.en: Ali grabbed my sleeve.
sentences.cn: 阿栗抓住了我的袖子。

sentences.en: 'Keep walking,' she said.
sentences.cn: "继续走，"她说。

sentences.en: 'Reading it means they see you back.'
sentences.cn: "看懂了就意味着他们也能看到你。"

situation:1.en: Rain poured down the cracked steps of Old Town. Zero stood at the far end, arms crossed, watching me. The *situation* was simple and terrible: one exit, one enemy, zero cover. I counted my steps and kept my face still, the way Grey Crow had taught me.
situation:1.cnHint: 旧城台阶前，叙述者面对零点，清醒地判断着眼前的____。
situation:1.hook: Zero smiled, and that smile meant the exit was already sealed.
situation:1.line: 'You read the *situation* fast — I will give you that.'

sentences.en: Rain poured down the cracked steps of Old Town.
sentences.cn: 雨水倾泻而下，冲过旧城的裂纹台阶。

sentences.en: Zero stood at the far end, arms crossed, watching me.
sentences.cn: 零点站在远端，双臂交叉，看着我。

sentences.en: The *situation* was simple and terrible: one exit, one enemy, zero cover.
I counted my steps and kept my face still, the way Grey Crow had taught me.
sentences.cn: 我数着脚步，保持着表情平静，就像灰鸦教我的那样。

order:1.en: The market stalls of Old Town lined the flooded street in perfect *order*, yet nothing here was innocent. Each vendor flag carried a color code. Grey Crow had shown me the key. Red meant danger. Blue meant wait. Every flag tonight was red.
order:1.cnHint: 旧城市集的摊位排列整齐，叙述者发现那种____背后藏着警告信号。
order:1.hook: The last flag at the corner was not red — it was black.
order:1.line: 'The *order* of these flags is a warning you cannot ignore.'

sentences.en: The market stalls of Old Town lined the flooded street in perfect *order*, yet nothing here was innocent.
Each vendor flag carried a color code.
sentences.cn: 每个摊位的旗子都带着颜色代码。

sentences.en: Grey Crow had shown me the key.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦把钥匙告诉过我。

sentences.en: Red meant danger.
sentences.cn: 红色代表危险。

sentences.en: Blue meant wait.
sentences.cn: 蓝色代表等待。

sentences.en: Every flag tonight was red.
sentences.cn: 今晚每面旗子都是红色。

event:1.en: The street festival should have been loud and bright, but this *event* felt wrong from the first step. Speakers buzzed at a frequency only I could hear. Hidden in the music was a countdown. Ali leaned close. 'Three minutes,' she said quietly. 'Then the signal drops.'
event:1.cnHint: 表面上是普通的街头____，叙述者却在喧嚣中听出了隐藏的倒计时。
event:1.hook: The music stopped with one minute still on the clock.
event:1.line: 'This *event* was never meant for the crowd.'

sentences.en: The street festival should have been loud and bright, but this *event* felt wrong from the first step.
Speakers buzzed at a frequency only I could hear.
sentences.cn: 扬声器以我唯一能听到的频率嗡嗡作响。

sentences.en: Hidden in the music was a countdown.
sentences.cn: 音乐里隐藏着一个倒计时。

sentences.en: Ali leaned close.
sentences.cn: 阿栗靠近我。

sentences.en: 'Three minutes,' she said quietly.
sentences.cn: "三分钟，"她轻声说。

sentences.en: 'Then the signal drops.'
sentences.cn: "然后信号就断了。"

account:1.en: Grey Crow handed me a paper card, soaked at the edges. On it was a single username — an *account* on the underground net. 'Every deal Zero ever made is in there,' Grey Crow said. We stood under a broken lamp in Old Town, rain loud on the stone.
account:1.cnHint: 引路人在旧城街头交给叙述者一张卡片，上面记着一个能揭露一切的____。
account:1.hook: The account had been accessed thirty seconds before I arrived.
account:1.line: 'This *account* holds every secret Zero thought was buried.'

sentences.en: Grey Crow handed me a paper card, soaked at the edges.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦递给我一张纸质卡片，边缘被浸湿了。

sentences.en: On it was a single username — an *account* on the underground net.
'Every deal Zero ever made is in there,' Grey Crow said.
sentences.cn: "零点做过的每一笔交易都在里面，"灰鸦说。

sentences.en: We stood under a broken lamp in Old Town, rain loud on the stone.
sentences.cn: 我们站在旧城一盏破损的灯下，雨声在石头上敲得很响。

deal:1.en: The handoff happened fast under the Old Town gate. A stranger passed Ali a small drive and walked on without a word. I had heard a *deal* like this described before, but seeing it in the rain made it real and dangerous. Someone above us was watching every second.
deal:1.cnHint: 旧城城门下，叙述者亲眼目睹了一次____的完成，感到危机逼近。
deal:1.hook: The stranger turned once at the corner and then was gone.
deal:1.line: 'A *deal* made in silence is the hardest kind to prove.'

sentences.en: The handoff happened fast under the Old Town gate.
sentences.cn: 交接在古城门下快速完成。

sentences.en: A stranger passed Ali a small drive and walked on without a word.
sentences.cn: 一个陌生人递给阿栗一个小硬盘，然后默默走开了。

sentences.en: I had heard a *deal* like this described before, but seeing it in the rain made it real and dangerous.
Someone above us was watching every second.
sentences.cn: 我们上面有人在每一秒都盯着。

degree:1.en: The signal grew stronger with every block I walked into Old Town. Grey Crow had said the source was close, but I had not expected this *degree* of noise — it hit like a wall of static behind my ears. Ali checked her device. The numbers were rising fast.
degree:1.cnHint: 叙述者走进旧城，信号强度达到了意想不到的____，令人震惊。
degree:1.hook: The static peaked, then cut to silence, then cut to a voice.
degree:1.line: 'I did not expect this *degree* of signal in the open street.'

sentences.en: The signal grew stronger with every block I walked into Old Town.
sentences.cn: 我每走进老城区一个街区，信号就强一分。

sentences.en: Grey Crow had said the source was close, but I had not expected this *degree* of noise — it hit like a wall of static behind my ears.
Ali checked her device.
sentences.cn: 阿栗检查了她的设备。

sentences.en: The numbers were rising fast.
sentences.cn: 数字在迅速上升。

worker:1.en: Rain hammered the old district. A *worker* in a grey coat painted coded symbols on a concrete wall, moving fast, head down. I watched from the shadow of a broken sign. Grey Crow had warned me: some painters were messengers. Others were traps.
worker:1.cnHint: 一名____正在旧城墙上涂抹神秘符号，叙述者悄悄观察。
worker:1.hook: The painter stopped, turned, and looked straight at me.
worker:1.line: 'That *worker* is not painting — he is writing a warning.'

sentences.en: Rain hammered the old district.
sentences.cn: 雨砸在古老的城区。

sentences.en: A *worker* in a grey coat painted coded symbols on a concrete wall, moving fast, head down.
I watched from the shadow of a broken sign.
sentences.cn: 我在一块破损招牌的阴影里看着。

sentences.en: Grey Crow had warned me: some painters were messengers.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦警告过我：有些画匠是信使。

sentences.en: Others were traps.
sentences.cn: 有些是陷阱。

control:1.en: The signal tower above Old Pier Road hummed with static. Whoever held that tower held *control* of every coded broadcast in the lower city. I pressed my back against a wet pillar. Ali crouched beside me, counting guards under her breath. There were too many.
control:1.cnHint: 叙述者和阿栗发现，夺取信号塔就能____整个下城区的广播。
control:1.hook: Then every guard's earpiece crackled at once — someone had heard us.
control:1.line: 'Lose *control* of that tower and we lose everything tonight.'

sentences.en: The signal tower above Old Pier Road hummed with static.
sentences.cn: 老码头路上的信号塔嗡嗡地放着静电噪音。

sentences.en: Whoever held that tower held *control* of every coded broadcast in the lower city.
I pressed my back against a wet pillar.
sentences.cn: 我把背贴在湿漉漉的柱子上。

sentences.en: Ali crouched beside me, counting guards under her breath.
sentences.cn: 阿栗蹲在我身边，低声数着下面的卫兵。

sentences.en: There were too many.
sentences.cn: 卫兵太多了。

product:1.en: Grey Crow slid a small chip across the cracked table outside the night stall. 'This,' he said quietly, 'is the *product* of three years underground.' It looked like nothing — a grey square no bigger than a tooth. But Ali's eyes went wide. She knew what it could unlock.
product:1.cnHint: 灰鸦拿出一枚芯片，说它是三年地下工作的____。
product:1.hook: Zero's shadow fell across the stall before either of us could move.
product:1.line: 'This *product* can bring the whole system down — or bury us.'

sentences.en: Grey Crow slid a small chip across the cracked table outside the night stall.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦在夜间小摊外的裂纹桌子上滑过一个小芯片。

sentences.en: 'This,' he said quietly, 'is the *product* of three years underground.'
It looked like nothing — a grey square no bigger than a tooth.
sentences.cn: 看起来一文不值——一个灰色的小方块，大小不超过一颗牙齿。

sentences.en: But Ali's eyes went wide.
sentences.cn: 但阿栗的眼睛睁大了。

sentences.en: She knew what it could unlock.
sentences.cn: 她知道它能打开什么。

practice:1.en: Every morning before the city woke, I ran the rooftops of Old Quarter. Not for sport — it was *practice*. Grey Crow said the day would come when I'd need to cross six buildings in the dark without a sound. That morning, standing in the rain, I finally believed him.
practice:1.cnHint: 叙述者每天清晨在旧城屋顶____，为某个关键时刻做准备。
practice:1.hook: A light clicked on in the window directly ahead — someone was already watching.
practice:1.line: '*Practice* until your feet know the path without your eyes.'

sentences.en: Every morning before the city woke, I ran the rooftops of Old Quarter.
sentences.cn: 城市苏醒前的每个早晨，我都在旧城区的屋顶上奔跑。

sentences.en: Not for sport — it was *practice*.
Grey Crow said the day would come when I'd need to cross six buildings in the dark without a sound.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦说总有一天我得在黑暗中无声地穿过六栋楼。

sentences.en: That morning, standing in the rain, I finally believed him.
sentences.cn: 那天早晨，站在雨中，我终于相信了。

environment:1.en: The lower streets of Old Quarter had changed. Acid fog rolled in from the bay, and the *environment* was hostile to both skin and signal — scanners misfired, comms cut out, and even Grey Crow's encrypted map showed blank blocks. We were moving blind through a city that was fighting back.
environment:1.cnHint: 旧城下层街道的____恶劣，雾气干扰了所有设备，让叙述者举步维艰。
environment:1.hook: Ali grabbed my arm: something large was moving inside the fog.
environment:1.line: 'This *environment* will kill your signal before Zero ever finds you.'

sentences.en: The lower streets of Old Quarter had changed.
sentences.cn: 旧城区的下层街道变了。

sentences.en: Acid fog rolled in from the bay, and the *environment* was hostile to both skin and signal — scanners misfired, comms cut out, and even Grey Crow's encrypted map showed blank blocks.
We were moving blind through a city that was fighting back.
sentences.cn: 我们在一座反抗我们的城市中摸黑前进。

system:1.en: The old transit hub was dead — trains hadn't run in forty years. But the *system* of tunnels beneath it still carried something: a ghost network, off every official map. Grey Crow called it the only free road left in Harbor City. I stepped into the dark and the smell of old iron closed around me.
system:1.cnHint: 废弃地铁站下方有一套隐秘的通道____，是旧城里唯一不受监控的路。
system:1.hook: Behind me, heavy boots hit the platform — someone had followed.
system:1.line: 'The old *system* still runs, just not the way the city knows.'

sentences.en: The old transit hub was dead — trains hadn't run in forty years.
sentences.cn: 老转运枢纽已经死了——火车四十年没有运行过。

sentences.en: But the *system* of tunnels beneath it still carried something: a ghost network, off every official map.
Grey Crow called it the only free road left in Harbor City.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦叫它港口城仅存的自由之路。

sentences.en: I stepped into the dark and the smell of old iron closed around me.
sentences.cn: 我踏入黑暗，陈铁的气味笼罩着我。

natural:1.en: Zero moved through crowds like water — no hesitation, no wasted step. It was *natural*, as if the city had grown around him rather than the other way round. I had been tracking him for six blocks through Old Quarter and had nearly lost him twice. He was not trying to hide. That was the frightening part.
natural:1.cnHint: 零点在旧城人群中穿行自如，那种从容让叙述者感到____得可怕。
natural:1.hook: He stopped at a corner, bought nothing, and said one word aloud.
natural:1.line: 'It looks *natural*, but every move he makes is a message.'

sentences.en: Zero moved through crowds like water — no hesitation, no wasted step.
sentences.cn: 零点在人群中流动得像水一样——没有犹豫，没有多余的步伐。

sentences.en: It was *natural*, as if the city had grown around him rather than the other way round.
I had been tracking him for six blocks through Old Quarter and had nearly lost him twice.
sentences.cn: 我在旧城区跟踪他六个街区，差点丢过他两次。

sentences.en: He was not trying to hide.
sentences.cn: 他没有试图隐藏。

sentences.en: That was the frightening part.
sentences.cn: 那才是可怕的地方。

traditional:1.en: The old quarter's streets were cracked and dark. A *traditional* signal lamp — three flashes, then two — still hung above the sealed metro gate. Grey Crow had told me: 'Old codes never die here.' I counted the flashes. Someone was still using it. Someone who knew the city before the neon arrived.
traditional:1.cnHint: 调查员在废弃地铁门上方发现一盏古老的____信号灯，仍在闪烁。
traditional:1.hook: The lamp flickered once more — then went dark forever.
traditional:1.line: 'That *traditional* code is the only lock Zero cannot crack.'

sentences.en: The old quarter's streets were cracked and dark.
sentences.cn: 旧城区的街道破裂而昏暗。

sentences.en: A *traditional* signal lamp — three flashes, then two — still hung above the sealed metro gate.
Grey Crow had told me: 'Old codes never die here.'
sentences.cn: 灰鸦告诉过我："老代码永远死不了。"

sentences.en: I counted the flashes.
sentences.cn: 我数了数闪光。

sentences.en: Someone was still using it.
sentences.cn: 有人还在用它。

sentences.en: Someone who knew the city before the neon arrived.
sentences.cn: 有人记得霓虹灯来临前的这座城市。

expert:1.en: Rain hit the stone road in hard sheets. Ali crouched beside the cracked drainage panel, fingers moving fast. 'She is an *expert*,' Grey Crow said behind me, voice flat. I watched her pull a thin wire from the gap and hold it to the dim light. She did not look up. She already knew what it was.
expert:1.cnHint: 阿栗是____，在旧城街道的排水板下找到了一根神秘的细线。
expert:1.hook: The wire hummed — and somewhere deep below us, a door unlocked.
expert:1.line: 'An *expert* planted this wire; only an expert can follow it.'

sentences.en: Rain hit the stone road in hard sheets.
sentences.cn: 雨在石路上砸出硬生生的雨幕。

sentences.en: Ali crouched beside the cracked drainage panel, fingers moving fast.
sentences.cn: 阿栗蹲在裂开的排水板旁，手指飞快地动作。

sentences.en: 'She is an *expert*,' Grey Crow said behind me, voice flat.
I watched her pull a thin wire from the gap and hold it to the dim light.
sentences.cn: 我看着她从缝隙里拉出一根细线，举到暗淡的光线下。

sentences.en: She did not look up.
sentences.cn: 她没有抬头。

sentences.en: She already knew what it was.
sentences.cn: 她已经知道那是什么了。

member:1.en: The graffiti on the old wall read: SEVEN KEYS. Below it, a small circle with a slash. Grey Crow pointed at it. 'Every *member* of Zero's network marks their route like this,' he said. The rain was washing the paint slowly away. I photographed it fast. One mark gone meant one path closed — forever.
member:1.cnHint: 灰鸦告诉调查员，涂鸦标记属于零点网络的某个____，雨水正在抹去线索。
member:1.hook: As the last mark faded, a figure turned the far corner.
member:1.line: 'Each *member* leaves one mark — find them all, find Zero.'

sentences.en: The graffiti on the old wall read: SEVEN KEYS.
sentences.cn: 老墙上的涂鸦写着：七把钥匙。

sentences.en: Below it, a small circle with a slash.
sentences.cn: 下面是一个小圆圈，中间一条斜线。

sentences.en: Grey Crow pointed at it.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦指向它。

sentences.en: 'Every *member* of Zero's network marks their route like this,' he said.
The rain was washing the paint slowly away.
sentences.cn: 雨在慢慢冲洗掉油漆。

sentences.en: I photographed it fast.
sentences.cn: 我快速拍下了照片。

sentences.en: One mark gone meant one path closed — forever.
sentences.cn: 一个标记消失意味着一条路永远关闭。

heart:1.en: We stood at the centre of the old quarter, where four broken roads met. Grey Crow called it the *heart* of the city's buried network — every hidden cable, every dead signal, every old code passed through this one cold spot. Ali knelt and pressed her hand to the wet ground. She felt it too.
heart:1.cnHint: 灰鸦指出旧城十字路口是地下网络的____，阿栗似乎也感受到了什么。
heart:1.hook: A low pulse rose through the stone — steady, strong, wrong.
heart:1.line: 'This corner is the *heart*; destroy it and the whole net dies.'

sentences.en: We stood at the centre of the old quarter, where four broken roads met.
sentences.cn: 我们站在老城区的中心，四条破碎的街道在这里交汇。

sentences.en: Grey Crow called it the *heart* of the city's buried network — every hidden cable, every dead signal, every old code passed through this one cold spot.
Ali knelt and pressed her hand to the wet ground.
sentences.cn: 阿栗跪了下来，把手按在湿漉漉的地面上。

sentences.en: She felt it too.
sentences.cn: 她也感觉到了。

within:1.en: The old district's underground tunnels ran *within* the city walls, hidden from every map I had ever seen. Grey Crow pressed a cold hand against the stone. 'Two signals,' he whispered. 'Both coming from below.' Rain dripped through the cracks above us. Something down there was still alive.
within:1.cnHint: 我和灰鸦发现信号来自城墙____的隧道深处。
within:1.hook: The signals stopped the moment I took one step forward.
within:1.line: 'Stay *within* these walls, or Zero will hear you.'

sentences.en: The old district's underground tunnels ran *within* the city walls, hidden from every map I had ever seen.
Grey Crow pressed a cold hand against the stone.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦把一只冰冷的手贴在石头上。

sentences.en: 'Two signals,' he whispered.
sentences.cn: "两个信号，"他低声说。

sentences.en: 'Both coming from below.'
sentences.cn: "都来自下面。"

sentences.en: Rain dripped through the cracks above us.
sentences.cn: 雨水从上方的裂缝滴落下来。

sentences.en: Something down there was still alive.
sentences.cn: 下面有什么东西还活着。

either:1.en: I checked both exits. *Either* route led straight into Zero's patrol zone. Ali crouched beside a broken lamp post, scanning the wet street. 'We can't stay here,' she said. The neon signs flickered once, twice, then died. Somewhere behind us, boots hit the pavement in a steady, cold rhythm.
either:1.cnHint: 两条路我____都不敢走，阿栗催促我们必须立刻决定。
either:1.hook: Then a third door appeared in the wall where none existed before.
either:1.line: '*Either* you trust Grey Crow, or we lose everything tonight.'

sentences.en: I checked both exits.
sentences.cn: 我检查了两个出口。

sentences.en: *Either* route led straight into Zero's patrol zone.
Ali crouched beside a broken lamp post, scanning the wet street.
sentences.cn: 阿栗蹲在一盏破损的灯柱旁，扫描着潮湿的街道。

sentences.en: 'We can't stay here,' she said.
sentences.cn: "我们不能留在这里，"她说。

sentences.en: The neon signs flickered once, twice, then died.
sentences.cn: 霓虹灯闪烁了一次，又一次，然后熄灭了。

sentences.en: Somewhere behind us, boots hit the pavement in a steady, cold rhythm.
sentences.cn: 身后某处，靴子踏在人行道上，节奏稳定而冰冷。

various:1.en: *Various* warning signs covered the alley wall — scratched symbols, painted numbers, torn code-strips left by runners before me. Grey Crow read each one without slowing down. 'They all say the same thing,' he muttered, pulling his coat tight. I copied the last symbol into my notebook. It matched the signal I had heard at dawn.
various:1.cnHint: 巷子里贴满了____种类的警告符号，灰鸦一眼看穿了它们的共同含义。
various:1.hook: The symbol in my notebook began to glow faint red.
various:1.line: '*Various* groups have passed here — none of them made it out.'

sentences.en: *Various* warning signs covered the alley wall — scratched symbols, painted numbers, torn code-strips left by runners before me.
Grey Crow read each one without slowing down.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦读着每一个标记，步伐没有放慢。

sentences.en: 'They all say the same thing,' he muttered, pulling his coat tight.
sentences.cn: "它们都说同一件事，"他低声说着，把外套裹紧。

sentences.en: I copied the last symbol into my notebook.
sentences.cn: 我把最后一个符号抄进了笔记本。

sentences.en: It matched the signal I had heard at dawn.
sentences.cn: 它和我黎明时听到的信号一致。

main:1.en: The *main* street of the old district was empty at this hour, which was wrong. It was never empty. Ali grabbed my sleeve and pointed at the shuttered shops. Every lock had been cut clean. Grey Crow said nothing, but his eyes moved fast across the rooftops. Whatever cleared this street had done it quickly and without a sound.
main:1.cnHint: 旧城____街道空无一人，阿栗发现所有锁都被整齐切断。
main:1.hook: A single light moved slowly behind the last shuttered window.
main:1.line: 'The *main* gate is sealed — Zero got here first.'

sentences.en: The *main* street of the old district was empty at this hour, which was wrong.
It was never empty.
sentences.cn: 这个时间段从来都不会空荡荡的。

sentences.en: Ali grabbed my sleeve and pointed at the shuttered shops.
sentences.cn: 阿栗抓住我的袖子，指着关闭的店铺。

sentences.en: Every lock had been cut clean.
sentences.cn: 每道锁都被整齐地割开了。

sentences.en: Grey Crow said nothing, but his eyes moved fast across the rooftops.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦没有说什么，但他的眼睛在屋顶上快速扫动。

sentences.en: Whatever cleared this street had done it quickly and without a sound.
sentences.cn: 不管什么东西清空了这条街，都做得既快又无声。

employee:1.en: A city *employee* in a grey uniform stood at the district checkpoint, scanning each pass with a dull expression. Grey Crow handed over a fake card without blinking. The scanner beeped green. But as we walked past, the employee's hand moved to a small device on his belt. Ali did not look back. I did.
employee:1.cnHint: 一名城市____在检查站扫描证件，灰鸦的假证通过了，但对方悄悄触碰了腰间的装置。
employee:1.hook: The device on his belt sent one short pulse into the dark.
employee:1.line: 'That *employee* works for Zero — I saw the mark on his collar.'

sentences.en: A city *employee* in a grey uniform stood at the district checkpoint, scanning each pass with a dull expression.
Grey Crow handed over a fake card without blinking.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦递出一张假卡，眼睛都没眨。

sentences.en: The scanner beeped green.
sentences.cn: 扫描仪发出绿灯。

sentences.en: But as we walked past, the employee's hand moved to a small device on his belt.
sentences.cn: 但当我们走过时，那个员工的手移向了腰间的一个小装置。

sentences.en: Ali did not look back.
sentences.cn: 阿栗没有回头。

sentences.en: I did.
sentences.cn: 我回了头。

class:1.en: Grey Crow called it a *class* of signal — a whole group of coded messages sharing one hidden frequency. 'Zero uses three of them,' he said, crouching over a street drain. 'We've only cracked two.' The rain filled the silence between us. Below the drain, I could hear a low hum that matched nothing in my training.
class:1.cnHint: 灰鸦解释说零点使用一种特殊____的信号，我们只破解了其中两种。
class:1.hook: The third class of signal was already broadcasting our location.
class:1.line: 'This *class* of code only appears when Zero is watching in person.'

sentences.en: Grey Crow called it a *class* of signal — a whole group of coded messages sharing one hidden frequency.
'Zero uses three of them,' he said, crouching over a street drain.
sentences.cn: "零点用了其中三个，"他蹲在街道下水道上说。

sentences.en: 'We've only cracked two.'
sentences.cn: "我们只破解了两个。"

sentences.en: The rain filled the silence between us.
sentences.cn: 雨水填满了我们之间的沉默。

sentences.en: Below the drain, I could hear a low hum that matched nothing in my training.
sentences.cn: 在下水道下面，我听到了一声低鸣，与我所有的训练都不符。

behavior:1.en: Zero's *behavior* had changed. Every report from the last week showed it — shorter moves, no patterns, no safe windows. Ali spread the notes across a dry step under an awning. 'Something scared him,' she said quietly. Grey Crow lit no lamp. He just stared at the map as the rain wrote dark lines across the paper.
behavior:1.cnHint: 零点近期的____发生了变化，阿栗认为他一定是受到了某种威胁。
behavior:1.hook: Whatever frightened Zero was still somewhere on this street.
behavior:1.line: 'His *behavior* changed the night the old tower went dark.'

sentences.en: Zero's *behavior* had changed.
Every report from the last week showed it — shorter moves, no patterns, no safe windows.
sentences.cn: 过去一周的每份报告都显示了这一点——移动更短，没有规律，没有安全窗口。

sentences.en: Ali spread the notes across a dry step under an awning.
sentences.cn: 阿栗在雨棚下的干燥台阶上铺开了笔记。

sentences.en: 'Something scared him,' she said quietly.
sentences.cn: "什么东西吓到了他，"她轻声说。

sentences.en: Grey Crow lit no lamp.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦没有点灯。

sentences.en: He just stared at the map as the rain wrote dark lines across the paper.
sentences.cn: 他只是盯着地图，雨水在纸上写出了深色的线条。

disease:1.en: 'Language is a *disease* here,' Grey Crow said, watching the coded graffiti spread block by block down the old district wall. Each new tag carried a fragment of Zero's signal, passed from hand to hand like an infection. Ali pulled me close. 'Don't read it aloud,' she warned. I had already read three words before she spoke.
disease:1.cnHint: 灰鸦警告说语言在这里像____一样蔓延，阿栗阻止我大声朗读墙上的密码。
disease:1.hook: The three words I read aloud began rearranging themselves on the wall.
disease:1.line: 'This *disease* spreads through sound — close your mouth, now.'

sentences.en: 'Language is a *disease* here,' Grey Crow said, watching the coded graffiti spread block by block down the old district wall.
Each new tag carried a fragment of Zero's signal, passed from hand to hand like an infection.
sentences.cn: 每个新标签都带着零点的信号碎片，从一只手传到另一只手，像一场感染。

sentences.en: Ali pulled me close.
sentences.cn: 阿栗把我拉近。

sentences.en: 'Don't read it aloud,' she warned.
sentences.cn: "不要大声念出来，"她警告道。

sentences.en: I had already read three words before she spoke.
sentences.cn: 她开口之前，我已经读了三个字。

compare:2.en: Deep under the old city, I found two maps pinned side by side on a cracked wall. One was printed decades ago; the other was fresh ink, still wet. I began to *compare* them line by line. The new map showed a tunnel that should not exist.
compare:2.cnHint: 我在地下发现了两张地图，开始____它们的差异，发现了一条不该存在的隧道。
compare:2.hook: Someone had been here minutes ago.
compare:2.line: '*Compare* the two routes — the difference will tell you everything.'

sentences.en: Deep under the old city, I found two maps pinned side by side on a cracked wall.
sentences.cn: 在老城市的深处，我找到了两张地图并排钉在一堵裂开的墙上。

sentences.en: One was printed decades ago; the other was fresh ink, still wet.
sentences.cn: 一张是几十年前印刷的；另一张是新墨迹，还很潮湿。

sentences.en: I began to *compare* them line by line.
The new map showed a tunnel that should not exist.
sentences.cn: 新地图显示了一条本不应该存在的隧道。

past:2.en: The tunnel walls were covered in dates and names scratched into the stone. Ali ran her light slowly across them. 'This is a record,' she said quietly. Someone had carved the *past* of Harbor City down here, away from every screen and every censor, hidden in the dark.
past:2.cnHint: 阿栗在地下隧道的石壁上发现了关于这座城市____的秘密记录。
past:2.hook: One name on the wall was mine.
past:2.line: 'They buried the *past* here so no one above could erase it.'

sentences.en: The tunnel walls were covered in dates and names scratched into the stone.
sentences.cn: 隧道的墙壁上刻满了日期和名字。

sentences.en: Ali ran her light slowly across them.
sentences.cn: 阿栗用灯光缓缓扫过它们。

sentences.en: 'This is a record,' she said quietly.
sentences.cn: "这是一份记录，"她轻声说。

sentences.en: Someone had carved the *past* of Harbor City down here, away from every screen and every censor, hidden in the dark.

suffer:2.en: The underground shelter smelled of old water and rust. Rows of low beds lined the walls. Ali knelt beside a torn blanket and said the people who hid here had to *suffer* through cold winters with no power, no signal, no way out. The silence after her words was very heavy.
suffer:2.cnHint: 阿栗在地下庇护所里说明了曾经藏身于此的人们所____的艰难处境。
suffer:2.hook: Then we heard movement — behind the far wall.
suffer:2.line: 'They chose to *suffer* in the dark rather than surrender their words.'

sentences.en: The underground shelter smelled of old water and rust.
sentences.cn: 地下避难所闻起来有陈旧的水和铁锈的味道。

sentences.en: Rows of low beds lined the walls.
sentences.cn: 一排排的低床沿着墙壁排列。

sentences.en: Ali knelt beside a torn blanket and said the people who hid here had to *suffer* through cold winters with no power, no signal, no way out.
The silence after her words was very heavy.
sentences.cn: 沉默之后的氛围非常沉重。

almost:2.en: I reached the signal relay box at the end of the passage and pulled it open. The device inside was *almost* destroyed — three of its four cores were black and dead. Only one still blinked a slow green pulse. That single light meant one channel was still open.
almost:2.cnHint: 我在通道尽头发现信号中继盒____已完全损毁，只剩一个频道还活着。
almost:2.hook: Someone had smashed it — from the inside.
almost:2.line: 'It is *almost* gone, but almost is not the same as gone.'

sentences.en: I reached the signal relay box at the end of the passage and pulled it open.
sentences.cn: 我来到通道尽头的信号中继盒前，拉开了它。

sentences.en: The device inside was *almost* destroyed — three of its four cores were black and dead.
Only one still blinked a slow green pulse.
sentences.cn: 只有一盏还在缓缓闪烁着绿光。

sentences.en: That single light meant one channel was still open.
sentences.cn: 那唯一的灯光意味着还有一条通道是畅通的。

especially:2.en: Grey Crow had left a crate of data chips in the sub-basement, each one labelled by district. Most were blank, wiped clean. But a few still held files, *especially* the ones marked with a small red dot in the corner. Those dots, Ali told me, meant the files were too dangerous to delete quickly.
especially:2.cnHint: 灰鸦留下的数据芯片大多被清空，____是那些标有红点的芯片，仍藏有危险文件。
especially:2.hook: The last red-dot chip was still warm.
especially:2.line: 'Guard these ones *especially* — they are what Zero is hunting.'
