sentences.en: Grey Crow had left a crate of data chips in the sub-basement, each one labelled by district.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦在地下室里留下了一箱数据芯片，每一块都按地区标记。

sentences.en: Most were blank, wiped clean.
sentences.cn: 大部分都是空白的，被彻底清除过。

sentences.en: But a few still held files, *especially* the ones marked with a small red dot in the corner.
Those dots, Ali told me, meant the files were too dangerous to delete quickly.
sentences.cn: 阿栗告诉我，那些圆点表示这些文件太危险了，无法快速删除。

publish:2.en: Tucked inside a hollow brick I found a thin paper booklet, hand-stitched and hand-printed. Someone had risked everything to *publish* it without a city licence. Each page listed names of people who had vanished. It was small enough to hide in a coat pocket and dangerous enough to end a career.
publish:2.cnHint: 我在砖墙空洞里发现了一本私自____的小册子，记录着所有失踪者的名字。
publish:2.line: 'They chose to *publish* the truth in secret rather than stay silent.'

sentences.en: Tucked inside a hollow brick I found a thin paper booklet, hand-stitched and hand-printed.
sentences.cn: 我在一块空心砖里找到了一本薄薄的小册子，手工装订、手工印刷。

sentences.en: Someone had risked everything to *publish* it without a city licence.
Each page listed names of people who had vanished.
sentences.cn: 每一页上都列着失踪人员的名字。

sentences.en: It was small enough to hide in a coat pocket and dangerous enough to end a career.
sentences.cn: 它小到可以塞进大衣口袋里，却危险到足以毁掉一个人的前程。

activity:2.en: The sub-basement had been empty for years, according to city records. But the dust told a different story. Fresh boot prints, a warm power cell, a half-eaten ration bar. There had been clear *activity* here within the last few hours. Whoever used this place had left in a hurry.
activity:2.cnHint: 城市档案显示地下室多年无人，但现场的痕迹表明最近有过____。
activity:2.hook: The ration bar brand had been illegal since 2091.
activity:2.line: 'This level of *activity* means they are still running an operation here.'

sentences.en: The sub-basement had been empty for years, according to city records.
sentences.cn: 按城市记录，这个地下室已经空置多年了。

sentences.en: But the dust told a different story.
sentences.cn: 但灰尘讲述了另一个故事。

sentences.en: Fresh boot prints, a warm power cell, a half-eaten ration bar.
sentences.cn: 新鲜的靴印、还有温度的能量电池、咬了一半的口粮。

sentences.en: There had been clear *activity* here within the last few hours.
Whoever used this place had left in a hurry.
sentences.cn: 这个地方在过去几小时内有人活动过。

science:2.en: On the deepest level I found a lab, small and stripped bare. One whiteboard remained. The equations on it mixed signal theory with language patterns in a way I had never seen. Grey Crow had once told me that in Harbor City, *science* and speech were the same crime when the city feared what you might prove.
science:2.cnHint: 我在最深处发现了一间废弃实验室，白板上的方程式说明____与语言在这座城市里同样危险。
science:2.hook: The equations ended with a question no one had answered.
science:2.line: 'They shut the lab because *science* was asking questions the city could not allow.'

sentences.en: On the deepest level I found a lab, small and stripped bare.
sentences.cn: 在最深的一层我找到了一间实验室，小得可怜，里面空空荡荡。

sentences.en: One whiteboard remained.
sentences.cn: 只留下了一块白板。

sentences.en: The equations on it mixed signal theory with language patterns in a way I had never seen.
sentences.cn: 上面的公式把信号论和语言学模式混合在了一起，我从未见过这样的东西。

sentences.en: Grey Crow had once told me that in Harbor City, *science* and speech were the same crime when the city feared what you might prove.

share:2.en: Ali pressed a cold metal disc into my palm inside the flooded maintenance tunnel. 'Your *share*,' she whispered. The disc held exactly half the access code we needed. Someone else was carrying the other half — someone we had not yet found.
share:2.cnHint: 阿栗在黑暗隧道里交给我属于我的那一____密钥。
share:2.hook: The other half was already moving toward the surface.
share:2.line: 'Take your *share* — and guard it with your life.'

sentences.en: Ali pressed a cold metal disc into my palm inside the flooded maintenance tunnel.
sentences.cn: 阿栗在淹没的维修隧道里把一个冷冰冰的金属盘塞进我的掌心。

sentences.en: 'Your *share*,' she whispered.
The disc held exactly half the access code we needed.
sentences.cn: 这个盘片里装着我们需要的访问代码的一半。

sentences.en: Someone else was carrying the other half — someone we had not yet found.
sentences.cn: 另一半在某个人手里——一个我们还没找到的人。

decade:2.en: The signal room had not been touched in a *decade*. Dust covered every console like grey snow. Yet one screen still glowed — a single blinking cursor waiting for input, patient as a trap. Zero had planned this long before I was ever recruited.
decade:2.cnHint: 那个信号室已封闭了____，却仍有一块屏幕在等待。
decade:2.hook: The cursor blinked once, then typed a word on its own.
decade:2.line: 'This room has been waiting a *decade* for someone foolish enough to enter.'

sentences.en: The signal room had not been touched in a *decade*.
Dust covered every console like grey snow.
sentences.cn: 灰尘像灰雪一样覆盖着每一台控制台。

sentences.en: Yet one screen still glowed — a single blinking cursor waiting for input, patient as a trap.
sentences.cn: 但有一块屏幕还在发光——一个孤独的闪烁光标在等待输入，耐心得像一个陷阱。

sentences.en: Zero had planned this long before I was ever recruited.
sentences.cn: 零点早在我被招募之前就已经策划了这一切。

kind:2.en: Grey Crow studied the coded graffiti on the tunnel wall and shook his head slowly. 'This is a rare *kind* of cipher,' he said. 'Only three people in Harbor City ever used it.' He paused. 'Two of them are dead.'
kind:2.cnHint: 灰鸦认出了墙上暗语的____，但这个发现令他沉默了。
kind:2.hook: He did not say who the third person was.
kind:2.line: 'I have seen every *kind* of cipher — but never one this dangerous.'

sentences.en: Grey Crow studied the coded graffiti on the tunnel wall and shook his head slowly.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦研究着隧道墙上的密码涂鸦，缓缓摇了摇头。

sentences.en: 'This is a rare *kind* of cipher,' he said.
'Only three people in Harbor City ever used it.'
sentences.cn: 「港城里只有三个人用过这种密码。」

sentences.en: He paused.
sentences.cn: 他停顿了一下。

sentences.en: 'Two of them are dead.'
sentences.cn: 「其中两个已经死了。」

across:2.en: I spotted the signal spike on my scanner and ran *across* the narrow underground bridge, water rushing black below me. Ali's voice crackled in my earpiece: 'Stop. The bridge is monitored.' I stopped at the centre, suspended between two dark shores.
across:2.cnHint: 我____一座地下窄桥时，阿栗警告我桥上有监控。
across:2.hook: A light blinked on, aimed directly at my face.
across:2.line: 'Once you walk *across*, there is no quiet way back.'

sentences.en: I spotted the signal spike on my scanner and ran *across* the narrow underground bridge, water rushing black below me.
Ali's voice crackled in my earpiece: 'Stop.
sentences.cn: 阿栗的声音在我的耳麦里劈啪作响：「停下。

sentences.en: The bridge is monitored.'
sentences.cn: 这座桥被监控了。」

sentences.en: I stopped at the centre, suspended between two dark shores.
sentences.cn: 我停在了中间，悬浮在两岸漆黑的水面之间。

factor:2.en: Ali laid three data chips on the wet floor and pointed at the middle one. 'Heat,' she said. 'That is the key *factor*. The chip only activates above thirty degrees.' I looked at my hands. Body warmth. We had exactly one chance.
factor:2.cnHint: 阿栗找到了激活芯片的关键____，而我们只有一次机会。
factor:2.hook: The tunnel temperature was dropping fast.
factor:2.line: 'Heat is the deciding *factor* — hold it in your palm, now.'

sentences.en: Ali laid three data chips on the wet floor and pointed at the middle one.
sentences.cn: 阿栗把三块数据芯片放在湿漉漉的地板上，指向中间那一块。

sentences.en: 'Heat,' she said.
sentences.cn: 「热，」她说。

sentences.en: 'That is the key *factor*.
The chip only activates above thirty degrees.'
sentences.cn: 「这块芯片只在三十度以上才会激活。」

sentences.en: I looked at my hands.
sentences.cn: 我看了看自己的手。

sentences.en: Body warmth.
sentences.cn: 体温。

sentences.en: We had exactly one chance.
sentences.cn: 我们只有一次机会。

condition:2.en: The old relay station was in terrible *condition*: wires hanging loose, walls sweating rust, half the floor submerged. But the broadcast antenna still pointed skyward through a crack in the ceiling. Zero had kept it broken on purpose, I realised — easy to miss, impossible to trace.
condition:2.cnHint: 废弃的中继站____很差，但零点故意让它保持这副模样。
condition:2.hook: A fresh footprint gleamed in the rust-stained water.
condition:2.line: 'Work with the *condition* you find — complaining costs time we do not have.'

sentences.en: The old relay station was in terrible *condition*: wires hanging loose, walls sweating rust, half the floor submerged.
But the broadcast antenna still pointed skyward through a crack in the ceiling.
sentences.cn: 但那根广播天线仍然笔直地穿过天花板的裂隙指向天空。

sentences.en: Zero had kept it broken on purpose, I realised — easy to miss, impossible to trace.
sentences.cn: 我意识到零点故意让它保持损坏状态——容易被忽视，却无法被追踪。

effort:2.en: I had spent two hours decoding the sewer map when Grey Crow appeared behind me. He studied my work in silence, then circled one small passage I had ignored. All that *effort*, and the answer had been in the one place I chose not to look.
effort:2.cnHint: 费尽____破译地图后，我发现答案就在我唯一忽视的地方。
effort:2.hook: The passage was just wide enough for one person.
effort:2.line: 'Good *effort* — but the city rewards the one who looks where it hurts.'

sentences.en: I had spent two hours decoding the sewer map when Grey Crow appeared behind me.
sentences.cn: 我花了两个小时破译下水道地图，这时灰鸦出现在我身后。

sentences.en: He studied my work in silence, then circled one small passage I had ignored.
sentences.cn: 他沉默地研究了我的成果，然后圈出了我忽略的一条小通道。

sentences.en: All that *effort*, and the answer had been in the one place I chose not to look.

receive:2.en: Deep under Old City, I pressed my palm against a cold pipe. A faint pulse. My implant lit up: I had just *received* a signal — seven short bursts, old morse rhythm — from somewhere behind the sealed wall. Nobody was supposed to be back there.
receive:2.cnHint: 在旧城地下，我从密封墙后____到一段神秘信号。
receive:2.hook: The seventh burst stopped mid-beat, and the wall began to move.

sentences.en: Deep under Old City, I pressed my palm against a cold pipe.
sentences.cn: 我把掌心贴在冰冷的管道上，身处老城区最深处。

sentences.en: A faint pulse.
sentences.cn: 一阵微弱的脉动。

sentences.en: My implant lit up: I had just *received* a signal — seven short bursts, old morse rhythm — from somewhere behind the sealed wall.
Nobody was supposed to be back there.
sentences.cn: 没人应该在那后面。

encourage:2.en: Ali crouched beside me in the flooded tunnel, her torch cutting thin yellow light. My hands were shaking over the junction box. She leaned close. 'You have done harder things,' she said, words steady and low, meant to *encourage* rather than comfort. I believed her. I started working.
encourage:2.cnHint: 在积水隧道里，阿栗用话语____我动手破解接线盒。
encourage:2.hook: Then her torch flickered once — and went out completely.
encourage:2.line: 'I only said it to *encourage* you — but I meant every word.'

sentences.en: Ali crouched beside me in the flooded tunnel, her torch cutting thin yellow light.
sentences.cn: 阿栗蜷缩在我身边，淹没的隧道里，她的手电切出一条细细的黄光。

sentences.en: My hands were shaking over the junction box.
sentences.cn: 我的手在配电箱上颤抖。

sentences.en: She leaned close.
sentences.cn: 她凑近了。

sentences.en: 'You have done harder things,' she said, words steady and low, meant to *encourage* rather than comfort.
I believed her.
sentences.cn: 我相信她。

sentences.en: I started working.
sentences.cn: 我开始动手。

travel:2.en: The data packet had begun its *travel* six hours ago from a node deep under Old City, bouncing through seven dead relays before landing in Grey Crow's cold hand. Each relay added a layer of noise. Each layer hid a name. One name was mine.
travel:2.cnHint: 一个数据包在旧城地下____了六小时，最终落入灰鸦手中。
travel:2.hook: Grey Crow looked up: 'It was never meant to reach me.'
travel:2.line: 'Its *travel* ends here — no further relays, no more hiding.'

sentences.en: The data packet had begun its *travel* six hours ago from a node deep under Old City, bouncing through seven dead relays before landing in Grey Crow's cold hand.
Each relay added a layer of noise.
sentences.cn: 每一层中继都增加了噪音。

sentences.en: Each layer hid a name.
sentences.cn: 每一层都隐藏着一个名字。

sentences.en: One name was mine.
sentences.cn: 其中一个名字是我的。

strong:2.en: The locked door was *strong* — reinforced alloy, no visible seam, the kind Zero's crew used to seal evidence rooms. I ran my fingers along the edge anyway. Ali had said: when a door looks perfect, look at the floor. I looked. There was a thin crack of light.
strong:2.cnHint: 这扇门看起来____无比，却在地面藏着一道光缝。
strong:2.hook: Something on the other side was breathing.
strong:2.line: 'The lock is *strong*, but the floor always tells the truth.'

sentences.en: The locked door was *strong* — reinforced alloy, no visible seam, the kind Zero's crew used to seal evidence rooms.
I ran my fingers along the edge anyway.
sentences.cn: 我的手指沿着边缘滑过。

sentences.en: Ali had said: when a door looks perfect, look at the floor.
sentences.cn: 阿栗说过：要是门看起来完美无缺，就看地板。

sentences.en: I looked.
sentences.cn: 我看了。

sentences.en: There was a thin crack of light.
sentences.cn: 有一道细细的光缝。

chance:2.en: Grey Crow gave me one look and said nothing. The corridor forked: left led back to the surface, right went deeper into Old City's buried grid. I had one *chance* to choose before the motion sensors reset. Wrong turn meant Zero's team would be waiting. I went right.
chance:2.cnHint: 走廊分叉，我只有一次____做出选择，否则将落入零点的埋伏。
chance:2.hook: Behind me, I heard the sensors click back to life.
chance:2.line: 'One *chance* — do not waste it on the wrong direction.'

sentences.en: Grey Crow gave me one look and said nothing.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦看了我一眼，什么都没说。

sentences.en: The corridor forked: left led back to the surface, right went deeper into Old City's buried grid.
sentences.cn: 走廊分叉了：左边通向地表，右边深入老城区埋藏的网格。

sentences.en: I had one *chance* to choose before the motion sensors reset.
Wrong turn meant Zero's team would be waiting.
sentences.cn: 走错了路零点的队伍就会在等我。

sentences.en: I went right.
sentences.cn: 我向右走。

solve:2.en: The cipher on the wall was nine characters, repeating. Ali photographed it; Grey Crow called it noise. But I had seen the same pattern on a dead man's sleeve two days ago. I needed to *solve* it before Zero did, or the name it protected would disappear forever.
solve:2.cnHint: 墙上的密码与死者袖口的图案相同，我必须在零点之前____它。
solve:2.hook: My tablet beeped: Zero's signal was already in this tunnel.
solve:2.line: 'We have maybe ten minutes to *solve* this — so think fast.'

sentences.en: The cipher on the wall was nine characters, repeating.
sentences.cn: 墙上的密码是九个字符，不断重复。

sentences.en: Ali photographed it; Grey Crow called it noise.
sentences.cn: 阿栗给它拍了照；灰鸦说那是噪音。

sentences.en: But I had seen the same pattern on a dead man's sleeve two days ago.
sentences.cn: 但我两天前在一具死人的袖子上见过同样的图案。

sentences.en: I needed to *solve* it before Zero did, or the name it protected would disappear forever.

quite:2.en: The underground archive room was *quite* different from what the map had promised: smaller, colder, and stripped bare except for one data card taped under the middle shelf. Someone had been here already. Someone had left that card on purpose. I picked it up and felt watched.
quite:2.cnHint: 地下档案室与地图上的描述____不同，只剩一张刻意留下的数据卡。
quite:2.hook: The card's single file was addressed to my name.
quite:2.line: 'It is *quite* clear someone wanted you to find this alone.'

sentences.en: The underground archive room was *quite* different from what the map had promised: smaller, colder, and stripped bare except for one data card taped under the middle shelf.
Someone had been here already.
sentences.cn: 有人已经来过这里了。

sentences.en: Someone had left that card on purpose.
sentences.cn: 有人故意留下了那张卡片。

sentences.en: I picked it up and felt watched.
sentences.cn: 我拿起它，感觉自己被盯着。

technology:2.en: The signal jammer filling the old subway shaft was unlike anything in the city's open market. Grey Crow knelt beside it, eyes narrow. 'Black-site *technology*,' he said quietly, meaning it had been built by people who did not officially exist. Ali and I traded a look. This changed everything.
technology:2.cnHint: 地下废弃地铁道里的信号干扰器使用了秘密____，让我们意识到事情远比想象复杂。
technology:2.hook: Grey Crow stood and said: 'Zero did not build this alone.'
technology:2.line: 'This *technology* should not exist — not here, not anywhere.'

sentences.en: The signal jammer filling the old subway shaft was unlike anything in the city's open market.
sentences.cn: 填满旧地铁竖井的信号干扰器是城市公开市场上找不到的东西。

sentences.en: Grey Crow knelt beside it, eyes narrow.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦跪在它旁边，眼神眯起。

sentences.en: 'Black-site *technology*,' he said quietly, meaning it had been built by people who did not officially exist.
Ali and I traded a look.
sentences.cn: 阿栗和我交换了一个眼神。

sentences.en: This changed everything.
sentences.cn: 一切都变了。

mind:1.en: Rain hammered the old street. A coded signal cut through the noise, and I felt it land inside my skull like a cold key turning. Grey Crow had warned me: in Harbor City, a sharp *mind* is your only real weapon. I pressed my back against the wet wall and listened harder. The signal was not random.
mind:1.cnHint: 在旧城街道上，叙述者意识到敏锐的____是在海港城生存的唯一武器。
mind:1.hook: The signal spelled a name — and it was mine.
mind:1.line: 'A sharp *mind* is the only lock they cannot pick,' Grey Crow said.

sentences.en: Rain hammered the old street.
sentences.cn: 雨砸在老街道上。

sentences.en: A coded signal cut through the noise, and I felt it land inside my skull like a cold key turning.
sentences.cn: 一个编码信号穿过噪音，我感觉它像冷钥匙一样在我脑子里转动。

sentences.en: Grey Crow had warned me: in Harbor City, a sharp *mind* is your only real weapon.
I pressed my back against the wet wall and listened harder.
sentences.cn: 我的后背贴着湿漉漉的墙，听得更仔细了。

sentences.en: The signal was not random.
sentences.cn: 信号不是随机的。

rise:1.en: I stood at the edge of the old canal district and watched the neon fog *rise* from the water in slow, glowing columns. Each column carried a fragment of a banned broadcast, visible only to those who knew how to look. Ali had taught me the trick last week. Tonight the fragments formed a warning.
rise:1.cnHint: 叙述者在旧运河区看到霓虹雾气____，其中隐藏着被禁播的信息碎片。
rise:1.hook: The last fragment read: 'Leave before the clock strikes zero.'
rise:1.line: 'Watch the *rise* of the fog — that is where they hide the words,' Ali said.

sentences.en: I stood at the edge of the old canal district and watched the neon fog *rise* from the water in slow, glowing columns.
Each column carried a fragment of a banned broadcast, visible only to those who knew how to look.
sentences.cn: 每一列都携带着禁播广播的片段，只有知道怎么看的人才能看见。

sentences.en: Ali had taught me the trick last week.
sentences.cn: 阿栗上周教过我这个技巧。

sentences.en: Tonight the fragments formed a warning.
sentences.cn: 今晚这些片段组成了一个警告。

prove:1.en: Zero had left a mark on the old bridge pillar — three slashes and a dot, the code for 'I was here first.' I photographed it with shaking hands. Grey Crow said I needed hard evidence to *prove* that Zero was the one jamming the city's signal towers. This mark was close, but not enough.
prove:1.cnHint: 叙述者在旧桥上找到零点留下的暗号，试图____零点就是干扰信号塔的人。
prove:1.hook: Then I noticed a second mark, fresher, still wet from the rain.
prove:1.line: 'You need more than a feeling to *prove* anything in this city,' Grey Crow said.

sentences.en: Zero had left a mark on the old bridge pillar — three slashes and a dot, the code for 'I was here first.'
sentences.cn: 零点在旧桥墩上留下了一个标记——三道斜杠和一个点，是"我先来过这里"的暗号。

sentences.en: I photographed it with shaking hands.
sentences.cn: 我用颤抖的手拍下了照片。

sentences.en: Grey Crow said I needed hard evidence to *prove* that Zero was the one jamming the city's signal towers.
This mark was close, but not enough.
sentences.cn: 这个标记接近证据，但还不够。

associate:1.en: I crossed the empty street toward the old print shop, its windows dark. People who *associate* with Grey Crow do not advertise it; they use blind drops and short signals. But someone had slipped a paper under the shutter with my code name on it. Only three people knew that name.
associate:1.cnHint: 叙述者来到旧印刷店，意识到与灰鸦____的人从不公开露面，但有人知道他的代号。
associate:1.hook: One of those three people was supposed to be dead.
associate:1.line: 'Anyone who *associates* with me becomes a target — remember that,' Grey Crow said.

sentences.en: I crossed the empty street toward the old print shop, its windows dark.
sentences.cn: 我穿过空荡荡的街道，走向旧印刷厂，窗户漆黑一片。

sentences.en: People who *associate* with Grey Crow do not advertise it; they use blind drops and short signals.
But someone had slipped a paper under the shutter with my code name on it.
sentences.cn: 但有人在百叶窗下塞了一张纸，上面写着我的代号。

sentences.en: Only three people knew that name.
sentences.cn: 只有三个人知道那个名字。

message:1.en: The graffiti on the underpass wall looked like noise — random shapes in red and black. I slowed my breathing and let my mind tune in. Beneath the surface pattern, a clean *message* appeared: 'The archive moves tonight.' Ali had told me to watch for exactly this kind of hidden text.
message:1.cnHint: 叙述者在旧地下通道的涂鸦中，解读出隐藏的____，得知档案今晚将被转移。
message:1.hook: If Zero had read it first, the archive was already gone.
message:1.line: 'There is always a *message* under the paint — you just have to slow down,' Ali said.

sentences.en: The graffiti on the underpass wall looked like noise — random shapes in red and black.
sentences.cn: 地下通道墙上的涂鸦看起来就像噪声——红黑相间的随意形状。

sentences.en: I slowed my breathing and let my mind tune in.
sentences.cn: 我放缓呼吸，让思绪调谐到这些图案上。

sentences.en: Beneath the surface pattern, a clean *message* appeared: 'The archive moves tonight.'
Ali had told me to watch for exactly this kind of hidden text.
sentences.cn: 阿栗告诉过我要留意这种隐藏文字。

development:1.en: Grey Crow spread a hand-drawn map on the wet pavement. It showed the old city's layout before the towers went up — before every new *development* swallowed another safe house. I counted seven safe houses crossed out in red. Only one remained, and it sat right at the edge of the flood zone.
development:1.cnHint: 灰鸦展示的旧城地图显示，每一次新的____都吞噬了一个安全屋，如今只剩最后一个。
development:1.hook: A light blinked on in the last safe house's window.
development:1.line: 'Every *development* in this district has been designed to push us out,' Grey Crow said.

sentences.en: Grey Crow spread a hand-drawn map on the wet pavement.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦在湿润的人行道上铺开一张手绘地图。

sentences.en: It showed the old city's layout before the towers went up — before every new *development* swallowed another safe house.
I counted seven safe houses crossed out in red.
sentences.cn: 我数了数，七个安全屋用红笔划了叉。

sentences.en: Only one remained, and it sat right at the edge of the flood zone.
sentences.cn: 只剩一个，而它就坐在洪水区边缘。

later:1.en: Ali handed me a small folded card and said not to open it yet. 'Read it *later* — only when the street is clear and no signal is running.' I slipped it into my coat and moved on. Three blocks ahead, a patrol drone turned and began drifting back toward me, its sensor light sweeping low.
later:1.cnHint: 阿栗交给叙述者一张纸条，让他____再看，但此刻一架无人机已经转向朝他飞来。
later:1.hook: The drone stopped directly above me and held still.
later:1.line: 'Open it *later* — if you read it now, they will see the light from your eyes,' Ali said.

sentences.en: Ali handed me a small folded card and said not to open it yet.
sentences.cn: 阿栗递给我一张折叠好的小卡片，说现在别打开。

sentences.en: 'Read it *later* — only when the street is clear and no signal is running.'
I slipped it into my coat and moved on.
sentences.cn: 我把它塞进外套，继续前行。

sentences.en: Three blocks ahead, a patrol drone turned and began drifting back toward me, its sensor light sweeping low.
sentences.cn: 前面三个街区，一架巡逻无人机转过身来，开始向我漂移，传感器光线在低处扫过。

maintain:1.en: The old signal tower at the street corner was still running — someone had worked hard to *maintain* it against the city's jamming field. A low hum told me it was live. Grey Crow had said there were people in the old district who kept the free channels open no matter the cost. I was finally standing next to one of their machines.
maintain:1.cnHint: 叙述者发现旧街角的信号塔仍在运行，有人不惜代价____着这座自由频道的机器。
maintain:1.hook: Then the hum changed pitch, and a voice crackled through — it was Zero.
maintain:1.line: 'We *maintain* this tower so the truth can still travel,' Grey Crow said.

sentences.en: The old signal tower at the street corner was still running — someone had worked hard to *maintain* it against the city's jamming field.
A low hum told me it was live.
sentences.cn: 低沉的嗡鸣声告诉我它在工作。

sentences.en: Grey Crow had said there were people in the old district who kept the free channels open no matter the cost.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦说过在旧城区有人，无论代价多大都坚持让自由频道保持开放。

sentences.en: I was finally standing next to one of their machines.
sentences.cn: 我终于站在了他们的机器旁边。

education:2.en: Beneath the old city, I found a cracked data-slate half-buried in wet concrete. The files inside held records of banned schools, erased teachers, children trained to forget. Someone had risked everything to preserve this *education*. A red light blinked at the top of the slate: a live tracker.
education:2.cnHint: 我在地下废墟中发现一块记录着被禁止的____的数据板，上面还有追踪信号。
education:2.hook: The tracker meant someone already knew I had found it.
education:2.line: Grey Crow said, 'This *education* is exactly what Zero wants destroyed.'

sentences.en: Beneath the old city, I found a cracked data-slate half-buried in wet concrete.
sentences.cn: 在旧城的地下，我找到了一块半埋在湿混凝土里的破裂数据板。

sentences.en: The files inside held records of banned schools, erased teachers, children trained to forget.
sentences.cn: 板子里面存着被禁学校、被抹去的教师、被训练遗忘的孩子的记录。

sentences.en: Someone had risked everything to preserve this *education*.
A red light blinked at the top of the slate: a live tracker.
sentences.cn: 数据板顶端闪烁着红灯——一个实时追踪器。

scientist:2.en: A locked steel box sat in the corner of the flooded tunnel. Inside, folded inside a dry cloth, was an ID card. The face on it belonged to a *scientist* the city had declared dead three years ago. Her name was still warm, somehow, in that cold underground air.
scientist:2.cnHint: 我在隧道里发现了一个盒子，里面有一张城市宣布已死亡的____的证件。
scientist:2.hook: Her listed lab address was only two blocks above my head.
scientist:2.line: Ali whispered, 'A *scientist* declared dead doesn't just leave her ID behind.'

sentences.en: A locked steel box sat in the corner of the flooded tunnel.
sentences.cn: 一个上锁的钢箱放在被淹没的隧道角落里。

sentences.en: Inside, folded inside a dry cloth, was an ID card.
sentences.cn: 里面，叠在一块干布里面，放着一张身份证。

sentences.en: The face on it belonged to a *scientist* the city had declared dead three years ago.
Her name was still warm, somehow, in that cold underground air.
sentences.cn: 她的名字在这冷冷的地下空气里，不知为何还带着温度。

physical:2.en: The old server room smelled of rust and standing water. Grey Crow handed me a thin card. On it was a map — not digital, not encoded, but a *physical* drawing made in ink on real paper. In 2099, paper was almost illegal. This map was more dangerous than any weapon.
physical:2.cnHint: 灰鸦给了我一张用墨水画在纸上的____地图，在2099年，纸张几乎是违禁品。
physical:2.hook: The ink was still damp — drawn within the last hour.
physical:2.line: Grey Crow said, '*Physical* proof is the one thing Zero cannot delete.'

sentences.en: The old server room smelled of rust and standing water.
sentences.cn: 旧服务器房间闻起来像生锈和积水。

sentences.en: Grey Crow handed me a thin card.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦递给我一张薄卡片。

sentences.en: On it was a map — not digital, not encoded, but a *physical* drawing made in ink on real paper.
In 2099, paper was almost illegal.
sentences.cn: 在2099年，纸几乎是违法的。

sentences.en: This map was more dangerous than any weapon.
sentences.cn: 这张地图比任何武器都危险。

quality:2.en: Ali pulled a data chip from behind a loose brick. She held it up to the faint light. 'Look at the edge,' she said. The finish, the weight, the perfect seal — every *quality* of it pointed to a government lab. Street dealers never made chips this clean. Someone powerful had left this here on purpose.
quality:2.cnHint: 阿栗发现一枚芯片，它的每一种____都指向政府实验室，绝非街头产品。
quality:2.hook: A door at the far end of the tunnel swung open on its own.
quality:2.line: Ali said, 'The *quality* of this chip means only one place made it.'

sentences.en: Ali pulled a data chip from behind a loose brick.
sentences.cn: 阿栗从一块松动的砖后面拔出一个数据芯片。

sentences.en: She held it up to the faint light.
sentences.cn: 她在微弱的光线下举起它。

sentences.en: 'Look at the edge,' she said.
sentences.cn: "看边缘，"她说。

sentences.en: The finish, the weight, the perfect seal — every *quality* of it pointed to a government lab.
Street dealers never made chips this clean.
sentences.cn: 街头贩子永远不会做出这么干净的芯片。

sentences.en: Someone powerful had left this here on purpose.
sentences.cn: 某个有权势的人故意把这个留在这里。

habit:2.en: I had worked underground cases before. Grey Crow once told me that every criminal carries a *habit* — a small repeated action that leaves a trace. Here it was: three spent signal flares, each placed exactly one metre apart. Precise spacing. A trained hand. Zero had been here, marking the path.
habit:2.cnHint: 灰鸦曾说每个罪犯都有一个____，而地下通道里的信号弹正是零点留下的痕迹。
habit:2.hook: The last flare was still faintly warm beneath my fingers.
habit:2.line: Grey Crow told me, 'Zero's *habit* will lead us straight to the next drop.'

sentences.en: I had worked underground cases before.
sentences.cn: 我以前做过地下案件。

sentences.en: Grey Crow once told me that every criminal carries a *habit* — a small repeated action that leaves a trace.
Here it was: three spent signal flares, each placed exactly one metre apart.
sentences.cn: 就是这样：三根用过的信号烟火，每根之间的间距精确是一米。

sentences.en: Precise spacing.
sentences.cn: 精确的间距。

sentences.en: A trained hand.
sentences.cn: 训练有素的手。

sentences.en: Zero had been here, marking the path.
sentences.cn: 零点来过这里，标记路径。

sound:2.en: The tunnel was silent except for dripping water. Then I heard it — a low, steady *sound* rising through the concrete floor, like a voice trapped under the stone. Ali pressed her ear to the ground and her eyes went wide. Whatever was making that noise was not a machine.
sound:2.cnHint: 隧道里传来一种从地板下升起的____，阿栗趴下来听后神色大变。
sound:2.hook: The sound formed a word, and the word was my name.
sound:2.line: Ali said, 'That *sound* is coming from a room that isn't on any map.'

sentences.en: The tunnel was silent except for dripping water.
sentences.cn: 隧道里除了滴水声什么都没有。

sentences.en: Then I heard it — a low, steady *sound* rising through the concrete floor, like a voice trapped under the stone.
Ali pressed her ear to the ground and her eyes went wide.
sentences.cn: 阿栗把耳朵贴在地面上，眼睛瞪得很大。

sentences.en: Whatever was making that noise was not a machine.
sentences.cn: 不管是什么发出那个声音，都不是机器。

average:2.en: The hidden file listed energy readings from twelve city blocks. Every block showed *average* power use — nothing strange, nothing flagged. Except block seven. Someone had faked the numbers there with almost perfect skill. Almost. I circled block seven on my map. That was where the signal was hiding.
average:2.cnHint: 文件显示十二个街区的能耗都是____水平，但第七区的数据是伪造的。
average:2.hook: Block seven was directly beneath the city's main broadcast tower.
average:2.line: I told Ali, '*Average* numbers in a place like that mean someone is lying.'

sentences.en: The hidden file listed energy readings from twelve city blocks.
sentences.cn: 隐藏文件列出了十二个城市街区的能量读数。

sentences.en: Every block showed *average* power use — nothing strange, nothing flagged.
Except block seven.
sentences.cn: 除了第七街区。

sentences.en: Someone had faked the numbers there with almost perfect skill.
sentences.cn: 有人用几乎完美的技巧在那里伪造了数字。

sentences.en: Almost.
sentences.cn: 几乎。

sentences.en: I circled block seven on my map.
sentences.cn: 我在地图上圈出第七街区。

sentences.en: That was where the signal was hiding.
sentences.cn: 那是信号藏身的地方。

body:2.en: Behind a false wall in the underground archive, I found a long metal case. Inside, wrapped in grey foam, was not a weapon or a drive — it was a cast, a perfect mould of a human *body*, small and precise. A child's shape. A serial number was stamped along the left arm.
body:2.cnHint: 假墙后的金属箱里装着一个人类____的精密模型，左臂上有编号。
body:2.hook: The serial number matched a file Zero had tried to erase last year.
body:2.line: Grey Crow said quietly, 'This *body* cast was made from a real person, still alive.'

sentences.en: Behind a false wall in the underground archive, I found a long metal case.
sentences.cn: 在地下档案馆的一堵假墙后面，我找到了一个长金属箱。

sentences.en: Inside, wrapped in grey foam, was not a weapon or a drive — it was a cast, a perfect mould of a human *body*, small and precise.
A child's shape.
sentences.cn: 一个孩子的形状。

sentences.en: A serial number was stamped along the left arm.
sentences.cn: 左臂上盖着一个序列号。

nearly:2.en: The tunnel beneath Old Town stretched for a long time. I moved through the dark, counting my steps. Water dripped from cracked pipes above my head. I had *nearly* reached the far wall when my light caught something — a folded note pinned to the stone, still dry, still fresh.
nearly:2.cnHint: 我在旧城地下隧道里摸索前行，____抵达尽头时发现了一张纸条。
nearly:2.hook: The handwriting on the note matched a dead man's file.
nearly:2.line: 'You *nearly* missed it — look closer at the fold.'

sentences.en: The tunnel beneath Old Town stretched for a long time.
sentences.cn: 旧城下方的隧道无限漫长。

sentences.en: I moved through the dark, counting my steps.
sentences.cn: 我在黑暗中摸索着，数着脚步。

sentences.en: Water dripped from cracked pipes above my head.
sentences.cn: 头顶上裂开的管道滴水不止。

sentences.en: I had *nearly* reached the far wall when my light caught something — a folded note pinned to the stone, still dry, still fresh.

wrong:2.en: Ali handed me a small metal card pulled from the drain pipe. Every symbol on it looked like a standard access code. But something felt *wrong* — the final digit was missing, replaced by a blank space, as if whoever made it wanted the reader to fill in the answer alone.
wrong:2.cnHint: 阿栗递给我一张金属卡片，但其中有____的地方让人生疑。
wrong:2.hook: Only one person knew what that blank space was meant to hold.
wrong:2.line: 'Something is *wrong* with this code — it was made that way on purpose.'

sentences.en: Ali handed me a small metal card pulled from the drain pipe.
sentences.cn: 阿栗从排水管里递给我一张小金属卡。

sentences.en: Every symbol on it looked like a standard access code.
sentences.cn: 卡片上的每个符号看起来都像标准的通行码。

sentences.en: But something felt *wrong* — the final digit was missing, replaced by a blank space, as if whoever made it wanted the reader to fill in the answer alone.

variety:2.en: The hidden shelf behind the old water pump held a *variety* of small objects: a cracked lens, a burnt wire coil, three glass chips of different colours. Each item came from a different part of the city. Someone had gathered them here over months, building a map no wall could hold.
variety:2.cnHint: 旧水泵后面的暗格里藏着____各异的物品，像是一张无形的城市地图。
variety:2.hook: Grey Crow had warned me about shelves like this one.
variety:2.line: 'This *variety* of parts — someone was building something hidden down here.'

sentences.en: The hidden shelf behind the old water pump held a *variety* of small objects: a cracked lens, a burnt wire coil, three glass chips of different colours.
Each item came from a different part of the city.
sentences.cn: 这些东西都来自城市的不同地方。

sentences.en: Someone had gathered them here over months, building a map no wall could hold.
sentences.cn: 有人花了几个月把它们聚集在这儿，堆砌成一张没有墙壁能承载的地图。

clear:2.en: The message was scratched into the floor of the old station with a sharp tool. Most of it had faded under years of grime. I wiped the surface with my sleeve until the words became *clear*: three short lines, a frequency number, and a time — tonight, two hours from now.
clear:2.cnHint: 我擦去污垢，地面上的信息变得____可辨，时间就是今晚。
clear:2.hook: Two hours was not enough time to warn anyone above ground.
clear:2.line: 'Now it is *clear* — they planned this meeting weeks ago.'

sentences.en: The message was scratched into the floor of the old station with a sharp tool.
sentences.cn: 这条信息被刻在了老车站的地板上，用尖锐的工具。

sentences.en: Most of it had faded under years of grime.
sentences.cn: 多年的污垢让大部分字迹都褪去了。

sentences.en: I wiped the surface with my sleeve until the words became *clear*: three short lines, a frequency number, and a time — tonight, two hours from now.

gain:2.en: Zero left nothing without a price. Ali explained it quietly as we crouched by the old signal box: every piece of information we found here was a *gain* for someone else too. The underground did not keep secrets. It traded them.
gain:2.cnHint: 阿栗提醒我，我们在地下得到的每一点____，同时也可能落入对手之手。
gain:2.hook: Behind us, a second set of footsteps had already stopped moving.
gain:2.line: 'Any *gain* we make down here, Zero sees it too.'

sentences.en: Zero left nothing without a price.
sentences.cn: 零点做任何事都要讨价还价。

sentences.en: Ali explained it quietly as we crouched by the old signal box: every piece of information we found here was a *gain* for someone else too.
The underground did not keep secrets.
sentences.cn: 地下没有秘密。

sentences.en: It traded them.
sentences.cn: 只有交易。

maybe:2.en: The door at the end of the passage had no lock, only a faint scratch mark shaped like a bird. I pressed my hand flat against it and pushed. It did not move. *Maybe* the mark was a warning and not a guide. I stepped back and looked again, this time at the floor.
maybe:2.cnHint: 通道尽头的门纹丝不动，我怀疑那个鸟形刻痕____是一个警告而非指引。
maybe:2.hook: The floor tile beneath my left foot clicked once and went silent.
maybe:2.line: '*Maybe* the mark means stay out, not come in.'

sentences.en: The door at the end of the passage had no lock, only a faint scratch mark shaped like a bird.
sentences.cn: 通道尽头的门没有锁，只有一道淡淡的鸟形划痕。

sentences.en: I pressed my hand flat against it and pushed.
sentences.cn: 我把手贴在门上，使劲推。

sentences.en: It did not move.
sentences.cn: 门纹丝不动。

sentences.en: *Maybe* the mark was a warning and not a guide.
I stepped back and looked again, this time at the floor.
sentences.cn: 我退后一步，再看一遍，这次我看向了地板。

huge:2.en: The chamber opened without warning. My small light could not reach the far end. The space was *huge* — wide enough to hold a crowd, tall enough that the ceiling disappeared into black. Someone had dug this out long before the city above it was built. It had been waiting.
huge:2.cnHint: 通道突然通向一个____的地下空间，远比任何人预料的都要宽阔幽深。
huge:2.hook: In the centre of the floor, a single chair faced the entrance.
huge:2.line: 'This place is *huge* — it was never on any city map.'

sentences.en: The chamber opened without warning.
sentences.cn: 暗室无声地敞开了。

sentences.en: My small light could not reach the far end.
sentences.cn: 我的小灯照不到对面的尽头。

sentences.en: The space was *huge* — wide enough to hold a crowd, tall enough that the ceiling disappeared into black.
Someone had dug this out long before the city above it was built.
sentences.cn: 这座城市在它之前建起来，早就有人挖掘出了这片空间。

sentences.en: It had been waiting.
sentences.cn: 它一直在等。

diet:2.en: The supply cache was small but strange. Canned goods, sealed pouches, a handwritten list on the lid. Someone had planned a long stay underground. The list read like a careful *diet* — exact amounts, exact times. Whoever left this had not planned to surface for weeks.
diet:2.cnHint: 补给藏点里有一份手写清单，像是为长期潜伏制定的____计划。
diet:2.hook: The date on the last pouch was tomorrow.
diet:2.line: 'This *diet* plan means they are still down here, still waiting.'

sentences.en: The supply cache was small but strange.
sentences.cn: 储备缓存很小，但很奇怪。

sentences.en: Canned goods, sealed pouches, a handwritten list on the lid.
sentences.cn: 罐头食品、密封小袋、盖子上手写的清单。

sentences.en: Someone had planned a long stay underground.
sentences.cn: 有人计划在地下待很久。

sentences.en: The list read like a careful *diet* — exact amounts, exact times.
Whoever left this had not planned to surface for weeks.
sentences.cn: 谁留下这个的，计划几周都不上去。

key:2.en: The old drainage tunnel smelled of rust and dead signals. Ali pressed her hand against the wet wall and found it — a small metal *key* taped inside a hollow brick. Grey Crow had left it before his arrest. Whatever door it opened, it was the answer we had been hunting for three nights.
key:2.cnHint: 阿栗在砖缝里找到了灰鸦藏下的____，那也许是破案的关键。
key:2.hook: But the lock it fit was nowhere on any map.
key:2.line: 'This *key* opens something they buried deeper than the tunnels,' Ali said.

sentences.en: The old drainage tunnel smelled of rust and dead signals.
sentences.cn: 老排水隧道闻起来像生锈和死寂的信号。

sentences.en: Ali pressed her hand against the wet wall and found it — a small metal *key* taped inside a hollow brick.
Grey Crow had left it before his arrest.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦被捕前留下了这把钥匙。

sentences.en: Whatever door it opened, it was the answer we had been hunting for three nights.
sentences.cn: 无论它开哪扇门，那都是我们三晚来一直在寻找的答案。

issue:2.en: Ali spread the yellowed pages across the drain cover. It was an underground *issue* of a banned newsletter, number forty-seven, printed on thin paper that crumbled at the edges. Someone had circled a single paragraph in red. The circled words were a warning, and they were dated yesterday.
issue:2.cnHint: 阿栗展开一份地下____，发现其中有人用红笔圈出了昨日的警告。
issue:2.hook: Whoever circled those words was already inside the tunnel.
issue:2.line: 'Every *issue* of this paper ends with a death,' Ali whispered.

sentences.en: Ali spread the yellowed pages across the drain cover.
sentences.cn: 阿栗把泛黄的纸页铺在排水井盖上。

sentences.en: It was an underground *issue* of a banned newsletter, number forty-seven, printed on thin paper that crumbled at the edges.
Someone had circled a single paragraph in red.
sentences.cn: 有人用红笔圈出了一个段落。

sentences.en: The circled words were a warning, and they were dated yesterday.
sentences.cn: 被圈出来的词是警告，日期是昨天。

against:2.en: I leaned *against* the cold iron door and listened. On the other side, Zero's voice moved through the dark, slow and careful, like someone reading from a list. He was naming people — our people. My hand found the signal jammer in my pocket. One click and he would know I was here.
against:2.cnHint: 我____着铁门偷听，零点正在念出我方人员的名单。
against:2.hook: He spoke my name last, then went silent.
against:2.line: 'Standing *against* that door won't save you from what's coming,' Zero said.

sentences.en: I leaned *against* the cold iron door and listened.
On the other side, Zero's voice moved through the dark, slow and careful, like someone reading from a list.
sentences.cn: 门的另一边，零点的声音在黑暗中缓缓移动，小心谨慎，像在读一份清单。

sentences.en: He was naming people — our people.
sentences.cn: 他在报人名——我们的人。

sentences.en: My hand found the signal jammer in my pocket.
sentences.cn: 我的手找到了口袋里的信号干扰器。

sentences.en: One click and he would know I was here.
sentences.cn: 按一下，他就会知道我在这儿。

raise:2.en: Zero stepped into the pale light and began to *raise* a flat black device above his head, slowly, the way someone lifts a flag. It was a signal booster — military grade, banned since 2087. One full transmission and every hidden channel in the old city would burn out. We had maybe forty seconds.
raise:2.cnHint: 零点缓缓____起一台军用信号增强器，一旦启动，地下所有隐秘频道将被摧毁。
raise:2.hook: Ali's hand was already on the wire cutter.
raise:2.line: '*Raise* it any higher and I cut the power right now,' Ali said.

sentences.en: Zero stepped into the pale light and began to *raise* a flat black device above his head, slowly, the way someone lifts a flag.
It was a signal booster — military grade, banned since 2087.
sentences.cn: 那是一个信号放大器——军用级的，2087年起就被禁用了。

sentences.en: One full transmission and every hidden channel in the old city would burn out.
sentences.cn: 一次完整的传输，旧城里所有隐蔽的频道都会烧毁。

sentences.en: We had maybe forty seconds.
sentences.cn: 我们顶多还有四十秒。

option:2.en: The passage split into three tunnels. Behind us, boots on stone — Zero's crew, closing fast. Grey Crow's last message had said to trust the water. The flooded left tunnel was the only *option* that made any sense now. I looked at Ali. She was already pulling off her boots.
option:2.cnHint: 身后有人追来，三岔路口中唯一合理的____就是那条被水淹的通道。
option:2.hook: The water was moving — something was moving in it.
option:2.line: 'There is no other *option*; we go left or we don't go at all,' Ali said.

sentences.en: The passage split into three tunnels.
sentences.cn: 通道分成了三条隧道。

sentences.en: Behind us, boots on stone — Zero's crew, closing fast.
sentences.cn: 身后传来脚步声在石头上回响——零点的人马在逼近。

sentences.en: Grey Crow's last message had said to trust the water.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦最后的信息说过要相信水的指引。

sentences.en: The flooded left tunnel was the only *option* that made any sense now.
I looked at Ali.
sentences.cn: 我看着阿栗。

sentences.en: She was already pulling off her boots.
sentences.cn: 她已经在脱靴子了。

society:2.en: Scratched above the sealed door was a small emblem — a crow inside a circle. Grey Crow had once told me that the old underground *society* used that mark to claim spaces they controlled. This door, this tunnel, this whole forgotten level of the city had once belonged to them. Now it belonged to Zero.
society:2.cnHint: 门上的乌鸦标志说明这里曾是地下____的领地，但如今已落入零点手中。
society:2.hook: And on the floor, fresh boot-prints led straight inside.
society:2.line: 'That symbol means the *society* never truly disappeared,' Grey Crow had warned me.

sentences.en: Scratched above the sealed door was a small emblem — a crow inside a circle.
sentences.cn: 密闭门上方刻着一个小徽章——圆圈里画着一只乌鸦。

sentences.en: Grey Crow had once told me that the old underground *society* used that mark to claim spaces they controlled.
This door, this tunnel, this whole forgotten level of the city had once belonged to them.
sentences.cn: 这道门、这条隧道、整个被遗忘的城市地下层曾经都属于他们。

sentences.en: Now it belonged to Zero.
sentences.cn: 现在归零点所有。

whole:2.en: Ali held up the cracked data chip to the one bare light above the pipe junction. 'The *whole* map is on here,' she said — every tunnel, every sealed door, every name Zero had erased from the city's records. Grey Crow had carried this chip for a decade. I finally understood why they had arrested him.
whole:2.cnHint: 那枚芯片里存有地下世界的____地图，这正是灰鸦被捕的真正原因。
whole:2.hook: If Zero knew we had it, we were already out of time.
whole:2.line: 'The *whole* truth is on this chip — and it will destroy him,' Ali said.

sentences.en: Ali held up the cracked data chip to the one bare light above the pipe junction.
sentences.cn: 阿栗把裂纹芯片举到管道枢纽上唯一的裸露灯泡下。

sentences.en: 'The *whole* map is on here,' she said — every tunnel, every sealed door, every name Zero had erased from the city's records.
Grey Crow had carried this chip for a decade.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦带着这块芯片走了十年。

sentences.en: I finally understood why they had arrested him.
sentences.cn: 我终于明白了为什么他们要逮捕灰鸦。

action:2.en: Deep under Old Town, Grey Crow handed me a cracked data-chip. 'Every *action* leaves a trace,' he said, voice flat as wet stone. I pressed the chip to my wrist reader. A map of tunnels blinked alive — tunnels that should not exist. Ali leaned close, breath sharp. 'That grid matches the sealed zone.'
action:2.cnHint: 在旧城地下，引路人交给我一块数据芯片，芯片记录的____让我看见了一片不应该存在的隧道。
action:2.hook: The tunnels led straight to Zero's last known position.
action:2.line: 'Every *action* leaves a trace — even the ones you buried.'

sentences.en: Deep under Old Town, Grey Crow handed me a cracked data-chip.
sentences.cn: 在老城区地下，灰鸦递给我一块裂纹芯片。

sentences.en: 'Every *action* leaves a trace,' he said, voice flat as wet stone.
I pressed the chip to my wrist reader.
sentences.cn: 我把芯片贴上腕部读卡器。

sentences.en: A map of tunnels blinked alive — tunnels that should not exist.
sentences.cn: 一张隧道地图闪亮登场——本不应该存在的隧道。

sentences.en: Ali leaned close, breath sharp.
sentences.cn: 阿栗靠得很近，呼吸急促。

sentences.en: 'That grid matches the sealed zone.'
sentences.cn: "那个网格和封闭区相符。"

program:2.en: I found a rusted terminal behind a false wall in the underground market. Its screen still glowed. One *program* remained open — a scheduler listing pick-up times, coded names, and a final entry: tonight, platform nine. Ali photographed every line. Grey Crow was already moving toward the exit, coat dripping.
program:2.cnHint: 在地下市场的暗格里，我发现一台终端机，里面一个____记录着今晚的可疑接送计划。
program:2.hook: Platform nine was three levels down and strictly off-limits.
program:2.line: 'This *program* has been running for six months without a single stop.'

sentences.en: I found a rusted terminal behind a false wall in the underground market.
sentences.cn: 我在地下市场一面假墙后找到了一台生锈的终端。

sentences.en: Its screen still glowed.
sentences.cn: 它的屏幕仍在发光。

sentences.en: One *program* remained open — a scheduler listing pick-up times, coded names, and a final entry: tonight, platform nine.
Ali photographed every line.
sentences.cn: 阿栗把每一行都拍了下来。

sentences.en: Grey Crow was already moving toward the exit, coat dripping.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦已经朝出口移动，大衣滴着水。

situation:2.en: The tunnel fork had no signs. Grey Crow studied both paths, then turned to me. 'Read the *situation*,' he said quietly. I listened: one path hummed with live current; the other was dead silent. Silence in a powered city means only one thing — a deliberate cut. Ali gripped my sleeve.
situation:2.cnHint: 面对地下岔路，引路人让我自己判断____，两条路透露出截然不同的信号。
situation:2.hook: Someone had cut the power on that path within the last hour.
situation:2.line: 'Read the *situation* before you move — one wrong step ends this.'

sentences.en: The tunnel fork had no signs.
sentences.cn: 隧道分叉处没有标记。

sentences.en: Grey Crow studied both paths, then turned to me.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦研究了两条路，然后转向我。

sentences.en: 'Read the *situation*,' he said quietly.
I listened: one path hummed with live current; the other was dead silent.
sentences.cn: 我听着：一条路发出活的电流的嗡鸣；另一条死一般的寂静。

sentences.en: Silence in a powered city means only one thing — a deliberate cut.
sentences.cn: 在有电的城市里，寂静只意味着一件事——人为的断电。

sentences.en: Ali gripped my sleeve.
sentences.cn: 阿栗紧紧握住我的袖子。

order:2.en: Scattered across the wet floor of the sub-level depot were torn slips of paper. I gathered them. When I placed them in *order* by the ink dates, a sentence assembled itself: 'The gate opens when the clock forgets.' Ali read it twice. Grey Crow said nothing, but his jaw tightened.
order:2.cnHint: 在地下仓库，我将散落的纸条按时间____排列，拼出了一句关于某扇门的神秘话语。
order:2.hook: The clock on the far wall had no hands.
order:2.line: 'Put them in *order* — the message only works as a sequence.'

sentences.en: Scattered across the wet floor of the sub-level depot were torn slips of paper.
sentences.cn: 地下仓库潮湿的地面上散落着撕碎的纸片。

sentences.en: I gathered them.
sentences.cn: 我把它们捡了起来。

sentences.en: When I placed them in *order* by the ink dates, a sentence assembled itself: 'The gate opens when the clock forgets.'
Ali read it twice.
sentences.cn: 阿栗读了两遍。

sentences.en: Grey Crow said nothing, but his jaw tightened.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦什么也没说，但他的下颌紧绷了。

event:2.en: Grey Crow pulled a thin logbook from a hollow brick. Its pages listed dates and short codes. One *event* stood out: three weeks ago, a power blackout lasting exactly four minutes, marked with a red star. 'That blackout wasn't a failure,' Ali said, finger on the page. 'It was a signal.'
event:2.cnHint: 引路人找到一本记录本，其中一个特殊的____——四分钟停电——被红星标记，原来是某种暗号。
event:2.hook: The same red star appeared on tonight's date.
event:2.line: 'That *event* was no accident — someone planned every second of it.'

sentences.en: Grey Crow pulled a thin logbook from a hollow brick.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦从一块空心砖里拽出一本薄薄的日志。

sentences.en: Its pages listed dates and short codes.
sentences.cn: 书页上记录着日期和短代码。

sentences.en: One *event* stood out: three weeks ago, a power blackout lasting exactly four minutes, marked with a red star.
'That blackout wasn't a failure,' Ali said, finger on the page.
sentences.cn: "那次断电不是故障，"阿栗的手指指向页面说道。

sentences.en: 'It was a signal.'
sentences.cn: "那是一个信号。"

account:2.en: Hidden inside a damp wall panel, I found a handwritten *account* of a meeting that never appeared in any official record. Three people, a locked room, a number exchanged. The handwriting was careful, almost too careful — as if the writer knew it would one day be found. Ali went pale.
account:2.cnHint: 我在墙板里发现一份手写的____，记载了一次从未出现在官方档案中的秘密会面。
account:2.hook: One of the three names listed was Grey Crow's.
account:2.line: 'This *account* names people who were supposed to never meet.'

sentences.en: Hidden inside a damp wall panel, I found a handwritten *account* of a meeting that never appeared in any official record.
Three people, a locked room, a number exchanged.
sentences.cn: 三个人，一间密闭的房间，一个交换的数字。

sentences.en: The handwriting was careful, almost too careful — as if the writer knew it would one day be found.
sentences.cn: 笔迹很工整，工整得过分——仿佛写的人知道有一天这会被发现。

sentences.en: Ali went pale.
sentences.cn: 阿栗脸色苍白。

deal:2.en: A chalk mark on the tunnel wall — two circles, one cross — was a street sign I had seen once in Grey Crow's notes. It meant a *deal* had been struck here, terms binding, no exit. Ali traced the mark with one finger. Somewhere nearby, water dripped in a slow, heavy rhythm.
deal:2.cnHint: 隧道墙上的粉笔暗号表示此处曾达成一笔____，条件苛刻，无路可退。
deal:2.line: 'A *deal* made in this tunnel stays in this tunnel — that's the rule.'

sentences.en: A chalk mark on the tunnel wall — two circles, one cross — was a street sign I had seen once in Grey Crow's notes.
sentences.cn: 隧道墙上的粉笔记号——两个圆圈，一个十字——是我曾在灰鸦笔记里见过的街道标记。

sentences.en: It meant a *deal* had been struck here, terms binding, no exit.
Ali traced the mark with one finger.
sentences.cn: 阿栗用一根手指描摹那个记号。

sentences.en: Somewhere nearby, water dripped in a slow, heavy rhythm.
sentences.cn: 附近某个地方，水滴以缓慢、沉重的节奏滴落。

degree:2.en: The sub-level air was cold, but the server room door was warm to the touch — warm to a *degree* that meant active machines, running hard, hidden from the city grid. Grey Crow pressed his ear against the metal. I checked my reader: no registered power draw. Zero had gone fully dark.
degree:2.cnHint: 地下服务器室的门板温度到了某种____，说明里面的机器正在悄悄高速运转，完全脱离城市电网。
degree:2.hook: Something inside that room was processing data at full speed.
degree:2.line: 'A heat rise of that *degree* means the system has been on for days.'

sentences.en: The sub-level air was cold, but the server room door was warm to the touch — warm to a *degree* that meant active machines, running hard, hidden from the city grid.
Grey Crow pressed his ear against the metal.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦的耳朵贴在金属门上。

sentences.en: I checked my reader: no registered power draw.
sentences.cn: 我检查了读卡器：没有注册的功耗显示。

sentences.en: Zero had gone fully dark.
sentences.cn: 零点已经完全黑掉了。

mind:2.en: Below Old Town, the tunnel smelled of rust and old rain. Grey Crow handed me a cracked data chip. 'Use your *mind*, not your eyes,' he said. The chip held no image — only a low hum that formed a single coordinate when I focused long enough.
mind:2.cnHint: 在旧城地下隧道里，灰鸦交给我一块芯片，要我用____来破解它。
mind:2.hook: The coordinate pointed somewhere that no map admitted existed.
mind:2.line: 'Use your *mind*, not your eyes — the chip speaks to thought, not sight.'

sentences.en: Below Old Town, the tunnel smelled of rust and old rain.
sentences.cn: 在老城区下方，隧道闻起来像生锈和陈年的雨。

sentences.en: Grey Crow handed me a cracked data chip.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦递给我一块裂纹芯片。

sentences.en: 'Use your *mind*, not your eyes,' he said.
The chip held no image — only a low hum that formed a single coordinate when I focused long enough.
sentences.cn: 这块芯片没有图像——只有一声低鸣，当我足够专注时会形成一个坐标。

rise:2.en: Deep in the Old Town drainage grid, a cluster of blank signal nodes lit up one by one. Ali read the pattern aloud: a *rise* in broadcast frequency every twelve seconds. Someone below us was transmitting, climbing the spectrum like a slow alarm, and they did not know we were listening.
rise:2.cnHint: 阿栗在旧城排水管道中发现信号频率出现____，暗示地下有人正在发送广播。
rise:2.hook: On the thirteenth second, the signal stopped — and footsteps began.
rise:2.line: 'A steady *rise* in frequency — someone down here wants to be heard.'

sentences.en: Deep in the Old Town drainage grid, a cluster of blank signal nodes lit up one by one.
sentences.cn: 在老城的排水网格深处，一簇空白的信号节点一个接一个地亮了起来。

sentences.en: Ali read the pattern aloud: a *rise* in broadcast frequency every twelve seconds.
Someone below us was transmitting, climbing the spectrum like a slow alarm, and they did not know we were listening.
sentences.cn: 我们下面有人在发送信号，频谱像缓慢的警报一样往上爬，他们不知道我们在监听。

prove:2.en: The flooded archive room under Old Town held rows of dead servers. I pulled one drive free and connected it to my scanner. If the data matched what Grey Crow suspected, it would *prove* the city council had buried the old language laws on purpose. The scanner spun. Silence.
prove:2.cnHint: 在旧城地下档案室里，我试图用一块旧硬盘来____市政厅掩盖语言法律的阴谋。
prove:2.hook: Then three red letters blinked: DENIED.
prove:2.line: 'This drive will *prove* they hid the law — if it still has power.'

sentences.en: The flooded archive room under Old Town held rows of dead servers.
sentences.cn: 老城下的泛滥档案室里摆满了死亡的服务器。

sentences.en: I pulled one drive free and connected it to my scanner.
sentences.cn: 我拔出一块硬盘，连接到我的扫描仪。

sentences.en: If the data matched what Grey Crow suspected, it would *prove* the city council had buried the old language laws on purpose.
The scanner spun.
sentences.cn: 扫描仪转动了。

sentences.en: Silence.
sentences.cn: 沉默。

associate:2.en: In the sub-level market beneath Old Town, I found Zero waiting at a broken fountain. 'I do not *associate* with investigators,' he said flatly. But his eyes moved to the package under my arm, and for one second his careful mask slipped. He knew what was inside before I spoke.
associate:2.cnHint: 在旧城地下市场，零点拒绝与我____，却在看到包裹时露出了破绽。
associate:2.hook: He reached out one gloved hand before he could stop himself.
associate:2.line: 'I never *associate* with your kind — yet here I am.'

sentences.en: In the sub-level market beneath Old Town, I found Zero waiting at a broken fountain.
sentences.cn: 在老城下的小市集里，我在一个坏了的喷泉旁找到了等待的零点。

sentences.en: 'I do not *associate* with investigators,' he said flatly.
But his eyes moved to the package under my arm, and for one second his careful mask slipped.
sentences.cn: 但他的眼睛移向我臂下的包裹，有一秒他那谨慎的面具滑落了。

sentences.en: He knew what was inside before I spoke.
sentences.cn: 在我开口前，他就知道里面装的是什么。

message:2.en: Scratched into the pipe wall at the lowest level of Old Town was a single line of code. Ali decoded it in under a minute. The *message* read: 'The word you need is already spoken — listen for the echo.' No name, no date. The graffiti was still warm to the touch.
message:2.cnHint: 在旧城最深层的管道墙上，阿栗破解了一条刻入的____，内容神秘，墨迹尚温。
message:2.hook: Somewhere in the dark, someone had just left in a hurry.
message:2.line: 'The *message* is fresh — whoever wrote this is still close.'

sentences.en: Scratched into the pipe wall at the lowest level of Old Town was a single line of code.
sentences.cn: 在老城最底层的管道墙上刻着一行代码。

sentences.en: Ali decoded it in under a minute.
sentences.cn: 阿栗在一分钟内破译了。

sentences.en: The *message* read: 'The word you need is already spoken — listen for the echo.'
No name, no date.
sentences.cn: 没有名字，没有日期。

sentences.en: The graffiti was still warm to the touch.
sentences.cn: 涂鸦还是温热的。

development:2.en: Grey Crow spread a map of Old Town across a damp crate. He traced the newest tunnel lines with one finger. 'Every *development* in this district hides a layer they don't show the public,' he said. The newest tunnels all converged on a single blank square at the centre of the map.
development:2.cnHint: 灰鸦向我展示旧城的地下建设____图，所有新隧道都指向地图中央一个空白区域。
development:2.hook: That blank square had no label — and no recorded owner.
development:2.line: 'Each *development* down here buries one more secret from the surface.'

sentences.en: Grey Crow spread a map of Old Town across a damp crate.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦在一个潮湿的箱子上展开了老城的地图。

sentences.en: He traced the newest tunnel lines with one finger.
sentences.cn: 他用一根手指描着最新的隧道线。

sentences.en: 'Every *development* in this district hides a layer they don't show the public,' he said.
The newest tunnels all converged on a single blank square at the centre of the map.
sentences.cn: 最新的隧道都汇聚在地图中心的一个空白方块上。

later:2.en: I found the sealed door on a second pass through the sub-level corridor. I had missed it earlier; *later*, I understood why — the door had no handle, no lock, only a faint heat signature that matched a living hand. Ali pressed her palm to the surface and the wall exhaled.
later:2.cnHint: 我第二次走过地下走廊时才注意到那扇门；____我才明白它为什么隐藏得如此之好。
later:2.hook: Beyond it was a room full of voices with nobody inside.
later:2.line: '*Later* you will understand — but right now, just press your hand here.'

sentences.en: I found the sealed door on a second pass through the sub-level corridor.
sentences.cn: 我在二次经过地下走廊时找到了那扇密封的门。

sentences.en: I had missed it earlier; *later*, I understood why — the door had no handle, no lock, only a faint heat signature that matched a living hand.
Ali pressed her palm to the surface and the wall exhaled.
sentences.cn: 阿栗把手掌按在表面上，墙壁呼出了一口气。

maintain:2.en: The old relay station under the canal district was still running. Zero stood at its centre, adjusting dials with careful hands. 'Someone has to *maintain* the old network,' he said, not looking up. 'Without it, half the encoded transmissions in the city go dark.' His voice held no pride, only tired duty.
maintain:2.cnHint: 在运河区地下中继站，零点独自____着旧网络的运转，语气中透着疲惫。
maintain:2.hook: He handed me a wire and said, 'Now you are part of this.'
maintain:2.line: 'I *maintain* this alone — and I have for three years without thanks.'

sentences.en: The old relay station under the canal district was still running.
sentences.cn: 运河区下的老中继站仍在运行。

sentences.en: Zero stood at its centre, adjusting dials with careful hands.
sentences.cn: 零点站在它的中央，用谨慎的手调整着刻度盘。

sentences.en: 'Someone has to *maintain* the old network,' he said, not looking up.
'Without it, half the encoded transmissions in the city go dark.'
sentences.cn: "没有它，城市里一半的加密传输就会黑掉。"

sentences.en: His voice held no pride, only tired duty.
sentences.cn: 他的声音没有骄傲，只有疲惫的责任感。

personal:2.en: Deep beneath Old City, I found a sealed locker. Inside: a damp notebook filled with *personal* notes — names, dates, coordinates. Not official records. Someone had been tracking these people privately, off the grid, for months. Grey Crow had warned me the old tunnels held secrets. He never said the secrets would have my own name on the last page.
personal:2.cnHint: 我在地下储物柜里发现了一本记录着____信息的笔记本，最后一页写着我自己的名字。
personal:2.hook: My name, written in a hand I did not recognise.
personal:2.line: 'These are *personal* files — someone built this list by hand.'

sentences.en: Deep beneath Old City, I found a sealed locker.
sentences.cn: 在老城的深处，我找到了一个密封的储物柜。

sentences.en: Inside: a damp notebook filled with *personal* notes — names, dates, coordinates.
Not official records.
sentences.cn: 不是官方记录。

sentences.en: Someone had been tracking these people privately, off the grid, for months.
sentences.cn: 有人一直在秘密跟踪这些人，脱离网络，已经好几个月了。

sentences.en: Grey Crow had warned me the old tunnels held secrets.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦警告过我老隧道里藏着秘密。

sentences.en: He never said the secrets would have my own name on the last page.
sentences.cn: 他从没说过秘密会有我自己的名字在最后一页。

rather:2.en: The tunnel was *rather* narrow, barely wide enough for one person. Ali moved ahead, torch low, scanning the walls. Coded graffiti covered every surface — not random tags, but a map. The air smelled of old copper wire and something burnt. Whatever had happened here, it happened recently. The paint was still soft.
rather:2.cnHint: 地道____狭窄，但阿栗发现四壁的涂鸦竟然是一张地图。
rather:2.hook: She touched the paint — her fingers came back red.
rather:2.line: 'It is *rather* strange — all these marks point the same way.'

sentences.en: The tunnel was *rather* narrow, barely wide enough for one person.
Ali moved ahead, torch low, scanning the walls.
sentences.cn: 阿栗走在前面，手电筒压低，扫描着墙壁。

sentences.en: Coded graffiti covered every surface — not random tags, but a map.
sentences.cn: 代码涂鸦覆盖了每一个表面——不是随意的标签，而是一份地图。

sentences.en: The air smelled of old copper wire and something burnt.
sentences.cn: 空气闻起来像古老的铜线和什么烧焦的东西。

sentences.en: Whatever had happened here, it happened recently.
sentences.cn: 无论这里发生了什么，都是最近才发生的。

sentences.en: The paint was still soft.
sentences.cn: 油漆还是软的。

instead:2.en: I expected empty tunnels below Old City. *Instead*, I found a humming server room carved into the stone, cables snaking across the floor like roots. Rows of black drives blinked in the dark. Someone was running a hidden network down here. Zero's signal had led me straight to it — or straight into a trap.
instead:2.cnHint: 我以为地下是空的，____发现了一个运转中的秘密服务器机房。
instead:2.hook: Behind me, the iron door swung shut with a click.

sentences.en: I expected empty tunnels below Old City.
sentences.cn: 我期待老城下是空荡荡的隧道。

sentences.en: *Instead*, I found a humming server room carved into the stone, cables snaking across the floor like roots.
Rows of black drives blinked in the dark.
sentences.cn: 一排黑色硬盘在黑暗中闪烁。

sentences.en: Someone was running a hidden network down here.
sentences.cn: 有人在这下面运行着一个隐藏的网络。

sentences.en: Zero's signal had led me straight to it — or straight into a trap.
sentences.cn: 零点的信号把我直接引到了它——或者直接引入了一个陷阱。

performance:2.en: A small screen on the wall looped a silent recording — Grey Crow's *performance* at last year's coded broadcast, the one the city censors had banned within an hour. Every gesture he made on screen was a signal. I watched it three times before I saw the pattern: coordinates, tapped out in plain sight, hiding in the rhythm of his hands.
performance:2.cnHint: 墙上的屏幕播放着灰鸦那次被禁的____，我终于看出了其中隐藏的坐标信号。
performance:2.hook: The third coordinate pointed directly beneath my feet.
performance:2.line: 'His *performance* was never art — it was a broadcast.'

sentences.en: A small screen on the wall looped a silent recording — Grey Crow's *performance* at last year's coded broadcast, the one the city censors had banned within an hour.
Every gesture he made on screen was a signal.
sentences.cn: 他在屏幕上做的每个姿态都是一个信号。

sentences.en: I watched it three times before I saw the pattern: coordinates, tapped out in plain sight, hiding in the rhythm of his hands.
sentences.cn: 我看了三遍才看到了规律：坐标，用他手的节奏敲出来，就在眼皮底下隐藏着。

percent:2.en: Ali pulled up the drive's data log on her wrist screen. 'Eighty *percent* of these files are wiped,' she said quietly. What remained was fragments — city grid maps, power schedules, a list of twelve names. Enough to suggest a plan, not enough to prove it. Zero had been careful. But careful people always leave that last twenty percent.
percent:2.cnHint: 数据已被删除八十____，但剩余的碎片暗示着一个针对城市电网的计划。
percent:2.hook: One surviving file was dated three hours from now.
percent:2.line: 'Eighty *percent* gone — but that is still enough.'

sentences.en: Ali pulled up the drive's data log on her wrist screen.
sentences.cn: 阿栗在她的腕屏上调出了硬盘的数据日志。

sentences.en: 'Eighty *percent* of these files are wiped,' she said quietly.
What remained was fragments — city grid maps, power schedules, a list of twelve names.
sentences.cn: 剩下的是碎片——城市网格地图、电源计划、十二个名字的列表。

sentences.en: Enough to suggest a plan, not enough to prove it.
sentences.cn: 足以暗示一个计划，但不足以证明它。

sentences.en: Zero had been careful.
sentences.cn: 零点一直很谨慎。

sentences.en: But careful people always leave that last twenty percent.
sentences.cn: 但谨慎的人总是会留下那最后的百分之二十。

achieve:2.en: The inscription was scratched low on the tunnel wall, easy to miss: 'To *achieve* silence, cut the voice at its root.' Below it, a crude diagram — the city's broadcast tower, a single line crossing its base. Someone had been planning this for a long time. Silence in Harbor City did not mean peace. It meant control.
achieve:2.cnHint: 墙上的刻字写道，要想____沉默，就必须切断声音的根源——那是一张针对广播塔的图谋。
achieve:2.hook: The diagram matched blueprints I had seen in Grey Crow's files.
achieve:2.line: 'They want to *achieve* silence — and they are close.'

sentences.en: The inscription was scratched low on the tunnel wall, easy to miss: 'To *achieve* silence, cut the voice at its root.'
Below it, a crude diagram — the city's broadcast tower, a single line crossing its base.
sentences.cn: 下方是一张粗糙的图——城市的广播塔，塔基穿过一条单线。

sentences.en: Someone had been planning this for a long time.
sentences.cn: 有人为这件事筹划了很久。

sentences.en: Silence in Harbor City did not mean peace.
sentences.cn: 港城的寂静并不意味着和平。

sentences.en: It meant control.
sentences.cn: 它意味着控制。

power:2.en: The lights died without warning. Every lamp in the tunnel, every blinking drive, every screen — gone. Then a low hum rose from beneath the floor, and red emergency strips flickered on. Ali grabbed my arm. 'They cut the main *power*,' she whispered. In the red half-dark, a figure stood at the far end of the passage, perfectly still.
power:2.cnHint: 地下隧道突然断____，昏红的应急灯下，通道尽头出现了一个一动不动的身影。
power:2.hook: The figure raised one hand — and the hum stopped.
power:2.line: 'Cut the *power* and you own the dark.'

sentences.en: The lights died without warning.
sentences.cn: 灯灭了，没有任何预警。

sentences.en: Every lamp in the tunnel, every blinking drive, every screen — gone.
sentences.cn: 隧道里每盏灯、每个闪烁的驱动、每块屏幕——全灭了。

sentences.en: Then a low hum rose from beneath the floor, and red emergency strips flickered on.
sentences.cn: 然后一阵低沉的嗡鸣从地板下升起，红色应急灯条闪烁开启。

sentences.en: Ali grabbed my arm.
sentences.cn: 阿栗抓住了我的手臂。

sentences.en: 'They cut the main *power*,' she whispered.
In the red half-dark, a figure stood at the far end of the passage, perfectly still.
sentences.cn: 在红色的半明半暗中，一个身影站在通道远端，纹丝不动。

within:2.en: The tunnel curved deep under Old City. Grey Crow pressed a cracked data-chip into my hand. 'Every answer is *within* this,' he said. The chip was warm, like it had been held for hours. I slipped it into my coat pocket and kept moving. The dripping walls felt closer now.
within:2.cnHint: 灰鸦将一块数据芯片交给叙述者，说所有答案都____这里面。
within:2.hook: The chip began to pulse — once, twice, then silence.
within:2.line: 'Every answer is *within* this chip — trust nothing else.'

sentences.en: The tunnel curved deep under Old City.
sentences.cn: 隧道在旧城下方深深地弯曲。

sentences.en: Grey Crow pressed a cracked data-chip into my hand.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦把一块裂纹的数据芯片塞进我手里。

sentences.en: 'Every answer is *within* this,' he said.
The chip was warm, like it had been held for hours.
sentences.cn: 芯片还很烫，像是被握了好几个小时。

sentences.en: I slipped it into my coat pocket and kept moving.
sentences.cn: 我把它塞进外套口袋，继续前进。

sentences.en: The dripping walls felt closer now.
sentences.cn: 滴水的墙壁感觉更近了。

either:2.en: Ali held two corroded keycards under the pale tunnel light. One opened the archive room. One triggered a lockdown. She could not tell which was which. 'I don't trust *either* of these,' she said, turning them over. Neither had a label. Somewhere ahead, a door was already sliding shut.
either:2.cnHint: 阿里手持两张门卡，对____都不信任，不知该如何选择。
either:2.hook: The sliding door's sound stopped — replaced by a low alarm.
either:2.line: 'I don't trust *either* of these — one is a trap.'

sentences.en: Ali held two corroded keycards under the pale tunnel light.
sentences.cn: 阿栗在苍白的隧道灯光下握着两张生锈的钥匙卡。

sentences.en: One opened the archive room.
sentences.cn: 一张打开档案室。

sentences.en: One triggered a lockdown.
sentences.cn: 一张触发封锁。

sentences.en: She could not tell which was which.
sentences.cn: 她分不出哪张是哪张。

sentences.en: 'I don't trust *either* of these,' she said, turning them over.
Neither had a label.
sentences.cn: 都没有标签。

sentences.en: Somewhere ahead, a door was already sliding shut.
sentences.cn: 前面某个地方，一扇门已经在关上了。

various:2.en: The underground archive was lined with shelves holding *various* data-plates, each stamped with a different district seal. Old City. Dock Ward. The Vents. I scanned the labels fast, looking for Zero's signal trace. Most plates were blank. One was not. Its seal had been scratched off by hand.
various:2.cnHint: 地下档案室中陈列着____种类的数据板，叙述者从中搜寻零的踪迹。
various:2.hook: The one unsigned plate was still warm to the touch.
various:2.line: 'These *various* plates hide one truth — find the unsigned one.'

sentences.en: The underground archive was lined with shelves holding *various* data-plates, each stamped with a different district seal.
Old City.
sentences.cn: 旧城。

sentences.en: Dock Ward.
sentences.cn: 码头区。

sentences.en: The Vents.
sentences.cn: 通风井。

sentences.en: I scanned the labels fast, looking for Zero's signal trace.
sentences.cn: 我快速扫描标签，寻找零点的信号踪迹。

sentences.en: Most plates were blank.
sentences.cn: 大多数盘片都是空白的。

sentences.en: One was not.
sentences.cn: 有一个不是。

sentences.en: Its seal had been scratched off by hand.
sentences.cn: 它的封印被手工刮掉了。

main:2.en: Grey Crow pointed to a faded map fixed to the tunnel wall. 'The *main* route is marked in red,' he said quietly. 'Zero uses it every time.' I traced the red line with one finger. It passed under the old market, then vanished at a spot marked with a single black cross.
main:2.cnHint: 灰鸦指出地图上的____通道，零每次都走这条路。
main:2.hook: The black cross on the map had been added recently — the ink was still wet.
main:2.line: 'The *main* route is marked in red — Zero always takes it.'

sentences.en: Grey Crow pointed to a faded map fixed to the tunnel wall.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦指向固定在隧道墙上的一张褪色地图。

sentences.en: 'The *main* route is marked in red,' he said quietly.
'Zero uses it every time.'
sentences.cn: "零点每次都用这条线。"

sentences.en: I traced the red line with one finger.
sentences.cn: 我用一根手指沿着那条红线描。

sentences.en: It passed under the old market, then vanished at a spot marked with a single black cross.
sentences.cn: 它穿过旧市场下方，然后在一个标有单个黑叉的地点消失了。

employee:2.en: A laminated card lay face-down in the dust near the tunnel's side door. I turned it over. The photo showed a young man, unsmiling. His title read: Staff *Employee*, Sub-Level Archives, Sector Nine. The access date printed at the bottom was three days from now. Someone had already planned ahead.
employee:2.cnHint: 叙述者在隧道中发现一张工作证，持证人是一名____，但日期指向未来。
employee:2.hook: The name on the card matched a face I had seen this morning.
employee:2.line: 'This *employee* badge was printed for a date three days away.'

sentences.en: A laminated card lay face-down in the dust near the tunnel's side door.
sentences.cn: 一张覆膜卡片脸朝下躺在隧道侧门附近的灰尘里。

sentences.en: I turned it over.
sentences.cn: 我翻了过来。

sentences.en: The photo showed a young man, unsmiling.
sentences.cn: 照片上是个年轻男人，面无表情。

sentences.en: His title read: Staff *Employee*, Sub-Level Archives, Sector Nine.
The access date printed at the bottom was three days from now.
sentences.cn: 底部印着的访问日期是三天后。

sentences.en: Someone had already planned ahead.
sentences.cn: 有人已经提前筹划好了。

class:2.en: The hidden room held rows of coded files, each tagged by *class*: low risk, guarded, forbidden. Most were low risk. Ali ran her finger along the forbidden row and stopped at a slim grey folder. No title. No date. Only a small symbol I had seen once before — on Zero's wrist.
class:2.cnHint: 密室里的文件按____分级，阿里在"禁止"级中发现了一个熟悉的符号。
class:2.hook: Ali pulled the grey folder free — and the lights cut out.
class:2.line: 'Every file in the forbidden *class* connects back to Zero.'

sentences.en: The hidden room held rows of coded files, each tagged by *class*: low risk, guarded, forbidden.
Most were low risk.
sentences.cn: 大多数风险等级低。

sentences.en: Ali ran her finger along the forbidden row and stopped at a slim grey folder.
sentences.cn: 阿栗沿着禁止区一行划过她的手指，在一个细长的灰色文件夹前停住。

sentences.en: No title.
sentences.cn: 没有标题。

sentences.en: No date.
sentences.cn: 没有日期。

sentences.en: Only a small symbol I had seen once before — on Zero's wrist.
sentences.cn: 只有一个小符号——我以前在零点的手腕上见过。

behavior:2.en: Grey Crow had been watching the tunnel junction for an hour. 'Something is wrong,' he said. 'Study the guard's *behavior*.' I looked. The guard paced the same five steps, stopped, checked his wrist, then paced again — every ninety seconds, without fail. It was too regular. Someone had programmed him.
behavior:2.cnHint: 灰鸦让叙述者观察守卫的____，发现对方的举止异常规律，像被操控一样。
behavior:2.hook: On the seventh cycle the guard looked straight at me and smiled.
behavior:2.line: 'Watch his *behavior* — no real person moves that perfectly.'

sentences.en: Grey Crow had been watching the tunnel junction for an hour.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦在隧道岔路口守了一个小时。

sentences.en: 'Something is wrong,' he said.
sentences.cn: "有些不对劲，"他说。

sentences.en: 'Study the guard's *behavior*.'
I looked.
sentences.cn: 我看了看。

sentences.en: The guard paced the same five steps, stopped, checked his wrist, then paced again — every ninety seconds, without fail.
sentences.cn: 警卫踱同样的五步，停下，检查手腕，然后继续踱步——每九十秒一次，没有偏差。

sentences.en: It was too regular.
sentences.cn: 这太规律了。

sentences.en: Someone had programmed him.
sentences.cn: 有人给他编了程序。

disease:2.en: The quarantine notice was still taped to the archive door, yellow and curling at the edges. Ali read it aloud: Sector Nine closed — *disease* risk, vector unknown. 'This is two years old,' she said. But the lock on the door was new. Shiny. Installed no more than a week ago.
disease:2.cnHint: 检疫告示称该区域因____被封闭，但门上的新锁说明有人最近才重新上锁。
disease:2.hook: Behind the door came the soft sound of someone typing.
disease:2.line: 'The *disease* warning is old — but that lock is brand new.'

sentences.en: The quarantine notice was still taped to the archive door, yellow and curling at the edges.
sentences.cn: 隔离通知仍然贴在档案室门上，泛黄，边缘卷起。

sentences.en: Ali read it aloud: Sector Nine closed — *disease* risk, vector unknown.
'This is two years old,' she said.
sentences.cn: "这是两年前的，"她说。

sentences.en: But the lock on the door was new.
sentences.cn: 但门上的锁是新的。

sentences.en: Shiny.
sentences.cn: 闪闪发亮。

sentences.en: Installed no more than a week ago.
sentences.cn: 最多一周前安装的。

worker:2.en: Deep under Old Harbor, I found a tunnel nobody had mapped. Scratched into the wet wall: a list of names. Each name belonged to a *worker* who had vanished from the city grid three months ago. Ali crouched beside me, her flashlight cutting the dark.
worker:2.cnHint: 我在地下隧道发现了一份失踪____的名单。
worker:2.hook: The last name on the list was mine.
worker:2.line: 'Every *worker* on that list clocked out the same night,' Ali said.

sentences.en: Deep under Old Harbor, I found a tunnel nobody had mapped.
sentences.cn: 在老港湾的深处，我找到了一条没人画过地图的隧道。

sentences.en: Scratched into the wet wall: a list of names.
sentences.cn: 刻在湿润的墙壁上：一份名单。

sentences.en: Each name belonged to a *worker* who had vanished from the city grid three months ago.
Ali crouched beside me, her flashlight cutting the dark.
sentences.cn: 阿栗蹲在我身边，她的手电筒切开黑暗。

control:2.en: A steel door blocked the tunnel's far end. A keypad glowed red. Zero's voice crackled through my earpiece: 'You have thirty seconds before they *control* the locks remotely and seal you in.' I stared at the nine digits. My fingers would not move.
control:2.cnHint: 零点警告我，对方将远程____所有门锁。
control:2.hook: The red light blinked once, then turned green on its own.
control:2.line: 'They *control* every exit in this block,' Zero said coldly.

sentences.en: A steel door blocked the tunnel's far end.
sentences.cn: 一扇钢门堵住了隧道的远端。

sentences.en: A keypad glowed red.
sentences.cn: 一个数字键盘闪着红灯。

sentences.en: Zero's voice crackled through my earpiece: 'You have thirty seconds before they *control* the locks remotely and seal you in.'
I stared at the nine digits.
sentences.cn: 我盯着九个数字。

sentences.en: My fingers would not move.
sentences.cn: 我的手指动不了。

product:2.en: Scattered across the tunnel floor lay dozens of silver capsules. Ali picked one up. Inside was a chip no bigger than a fingernail. 'This chip,' she said quietly, 'is the *product* of ten years of banned research — it can rewrite a person's memory.' I set mine down very carefully.
product:2.cnHint: 我们在隧道里发现了违禁研究的____。
product:2.hook: One capsule was already open, and empty.
product:2.line: 'This is the *product* they were willing to kill for,' Ali whispered.

sentences.en: Scattered across the tunnel floor lay dozens of silver capsules.
sentences.cn: 隧道地板上散落着几十个银色胶囊。

sentences.en: Ali picked one up.
sentences.cn: 阿栗捡起了其中一个。

sentences.en: Inside was a chip no bigger than a fingernail.
sentences.cn: 里面是一块指甲盖大小的芯片。

sentences.en: 'This chip,' she said quietly, 'is the *product* of ten years of banned research — it can rewrite a person's memory.'
I set mine down very carefully.
sentences.cn: 我小心翼翼地把我的放了下去。

practice:2.en: Old symbols covered the tunnel walls — a cipher Grey Crow had once shown me. 'We used this as *practice*,' he had said, 'before the real transmissions began.' Now the symbols spelled out coordinates. Someone else had learned the same cipher. Someone who should not have.
practice:2.cnHint: 墙上的暗号曾被灰鸦用来做____，如今出现在禁区深处。
practice:2.hook: The coordinates pointed to the city's central power core.
practice:2.line: Grey Crow said, 'That cipher was only *practice* — or so I thought.'

sentences.en: Old symbols covered the tunnel walls — a cipher Grey Crow had once shown me.
sentences.cn: 旧符号覆盖了隧道的墙壁——这是灰鸦曾经给我看过的密码。

sentences.en: 'We used this as *practice*,' he had said, 'before the real transmissions began.'
Now the symbols spelled out coordinates.
